def_zh: 住宿；住處
def_en: a place to live, work, or stay in, especially on holiday or for students
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，切勿加 -s；注意雙寫 cc 及雙寫 mm，常搭配 provide accommodation for sb。
example: The university provides affordable on-campus accommodation for all first-year international students arriving this September.

def_zh: 問卷；調查表
def_en: a list of questions that several people are asked so that information can be collected
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 nn 及字尾 -aire；完成問卷用 fill in / complete a questionnaire，回應問卷用 respond to。
example: All participants must complete a short feedback questionnaire before leaving the community workshop this afternoon.

def_zh: 紀念品；手信
def_en: something you buy or keep to help you remember a holiday or special event
prep_trap: 可數名詞，複數需加 -s；注意字尾為 -nir 而非 -nier，表「某地的紀念品」用 a souvenir of/from。
example: Every visitor attending the annual cultural festival will receive a handmade keychain as a free souvenir.

def_zh: 行程表；旅遊路線
def_en: a detailed plan or route of a journey
prep_trap: 複數為 itineraries；在行程表上用 on the itinerary，為某旅程設計行程用 an itinerary for the trip。
example: Please find attached the updated three-day study tour itinerary for our upcoming visit to Singapore.

def_zh: 委員會
def_en: a small group of people chosen to represent a larger organization and make decisions
prep_trap: 極易漏寫雙字母：雙寫 mm、雙寫 tt、雙寫 ee；身為委員會成員介詞必須用 on the committee。
example: The organizing committee has decided to postpone the charity concert until next Friday due to rain.

def_zh: 茶點；點心與飲料
def_en: small amounts of food and drink provided at an event or meeting
prep_trap: 在 Paper 3 指活動茶點時必須使用複數形 refreshments；常搭配動詞 serve 或 provide。
example: Light refreshments and bottled water will be served in the school hall after the opening ceremony.

def_zh: 週年紀念日
def_en: the day on which an important event happened in a previous year
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 nn 及中間是 -ver- 而非 -var-；在週年紀念日當天介詞用 on the anniversary of。
example: Our school is organizing a grand musical performance to celebrate its fiftieth anniversary next month.

def_zh: 展覽會；展覽
def_en: an event at which objects such as paintings or products are shown to the public
prep_trap: 注意中間有不發音的 h（ex-hi-bi-tion）；在展覽中展出用 on exhibition 或 at the exhibition。
example: The photography club will hold a three-day exhibition in the library to showcase student works.

def_zh: 宣傳小冊子；指南
def_en: a type of small magazine that contains pictures and information on a product or company
prep_trap: 注意字中為 ch 而非 sh（bro-chure）；小冊子內的資訊介詞用 in the brochure。
example: Interested students can pick up an information brochure at the reception counter during lunch break.

def_zh: 薄冊子；傳單
def_en: a thin book with only a few pages that gives information or an opinion about something
prep_trap: 注意中間發 /f/ 音的是 ph 而非 f（pam-phlet）；關於某主題的傳單用 a pamphlet on/about。
example: Volunteers distributed educational pamphlets on recycling to residents living in the nearby public housing estate.

def_zh: 報名；入學；註冊人數
def_en: the act of officially joining a course, school, or service, or the number of people who join
prep_trap: 英式拼法亦作 enrolment（單 l）；報名某課程介詞搭配 enrollment in/for a course。
example: Online enrollment for the summer leadership training camp will officially close this Friday at five o'clock.

def_zh: 證書；證明書
def_en: an official document that states that the information on it is true
prep_trap: 注意首音節是 cer- 而非 cir-；出席證書固定搭配為 a certificate of attendance/completion。
example: Participants who attend at least four sessions will be awarded an official certificate of completion.

def_zh: 禮堂；觀眾席
def_en: a large room or building where meetings, concerts, or speeches are held
prep_trap: 注意開頭為 au- 而非 or-；在禮堂內舉行活動介詞用 in the auditorium。
example: The guest lecture on career planning will take place in the main auditorium tomorrow morning.

def_zh: 體育館；健身房
def_en: a large room with equipment for exercising the body and increasing strength
prep_trap: 注意首音節為 gym-；Paper 3 錄音常讀全稱 gymnasium，切勿拼錯中間的 -na-si-um。
example: Due to bad weather, the inter-class basketball match has been moved to the indoor gymnasium.

def_zh: 自助餐廳；學校飯堂
def_en: a restaurant, often in a school or hospital, where people collect food on trays themselves
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -fe-te- 而非 -fa-ta-；在飯堂用膳介詞用 at/in the cafeteria。
example: The student union suggested offering more vegetarian meal options in the school cafeteria next term.

def_zh: 實驗室
def_en: a room or building with scientific equipment for doing scientific tests or for teaching science
prep_trap: 注意中間有 o（la-bor-a-to-ry），英式發音常弱化卻不可漏寫；複數為 laboratories。
example: Students must wear protective goggles at all times when conducting experiments in the chemistry laboratory.

def_zh: 學生宿舍；集體寢室
def_en: a large building at a college or school where students live and sleep
prep_trap: 注意中間是 i（dor-mi-to-ry），複數需改 y 為 -ies（dormitories）；住在宿舍用 live in a dormitory。
example: Living in a university dormitory allows freshmen to build lifelong friendships and learn independent living skills.

def_zh: 維修；保養；維持
def_en: the work needed to keep a road, building, machine, or system in good condition
prep_trap: 極高頻拼錯字！中間是 -ten- 而非 -tain-（受動詞 maintain 誤導）；不可數名詞，正在維修用 under maintenance。
example: The swimming pool will be closed for two days next week for routine facility maintenance.

def_zh: 翻新；裝修；整修
def_en: the act or process of repairing and improving something, especially a building
prep_trap: 注意單寫 n（ren-o-va-tion）；表示「正在裝修中」固定搭配介詞 under renovation。
example: The public library is currently under renovation and will reopen to residents in late December.

def_zh: 登記；註冊；報到
def_en: the act of recording a name or information on an official list
prep_trap: 動詞為 register，變名詞時刪去 e 變 -tration（reg-is-tra-tion），切勿多寫 e。
example: Prior online registration is required because seating in the lecture theatre is strictly limited.

def_zh: 訂閱；訂金；會費
def_en: an amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a product or service
prep_trap: 動詞為 subscribe（字尾 b），變名詞時 b 必須轉為 p（sub-scrip-tion）；訂閱某刊物介詞用 to。
example: Students can enjoy a twenty percent discount on an annual subscription to the science magazine.

def_zh: 通告；宣布；廣播
def_en: something that someone says officially, giving information about something
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 nn 且保留 e（an-nounce-ment）；發表通告用 make an announcement。
example: The principal made an important announcement regarding the new school uniform policy during morning assembly.

def_zh: 通信；往來書信或電郵
def_en: letters or emails sent between people, or the process of sending and receiving them
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，切勿加 -s；注意雙寫 rr 及字尾為 -ence 而非 -ance；與某人通信用 correspondence with sb。
example: Please direct all future correspondence regarding the sponsorship agreement to our marketing manager via email.

def_zh: 代表；代理人
def_en: someone who speaks or does something officially for another person or group of people
prep_trap: 可數名詞，指人時需注意單複數（a representative / representatives）；某機構的代表用 a representative of。
example: Each class should elect two representatives to attend the student council meeting this Thursday afternoon.

def_zh: 統籌員；協調人
def_en: someone whose job is to make different groups work together in an organized way
prep_trap: 注意開頭雙 o（co-or-di-na-tor）及字尾為 -tor 而非 -ter。
example: If you have any dietary restrictions, please inform the camp coordinator at least three days beforehand.

def_zh: 接待員；前台職員
def_en: a person who works in a place such as a hotel, office, or hospital and welcomes visitors
prep_trap: 注意由 receive 轉變時為 -cep-（re-cep-tion-ist）；提交表格給接待員用 hand in to the receptionist。
example: Visitors are required to sign in with the receptionist on the ground floor upon arrival.

def_zh: 技術員；技師
def_en: a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering
prep_trap: 注意中間有 ch（tech-）且字尾為 -cian（指專業人員，如 musician），切勿拼成 -tian 或 -sion。
example: Our school hired an experienced computer technician to upgrade the wireless network across the campus.

def_zh: 營養師
def_en: an expert on the subject of nutrition and how food affects health
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -tri-tion-ist；向營養師諮詢用 consult a nutritionist。
example: We have invited a registered nutritionist to deliver a talk on healthy eating habits next Monday.

def_zh: 議員（如區議員）
def_en: an elected member of a local government council
prep_trap: 極易與 counsellor（輔導員）混淆！councillor 指議會（council）成員，香港語境常指 District Councillor（區議員）。
example: The local district councillor promised to urge the government to build more elderly fitness facilities.

def_zh: 輔導員；顧問
def_en: someone who is trained to listen to people and give them advice about their problems
prep_trap: 與 councillor 同音異義！counsellor（中間為 s）指提供心理或學業輔導的人（school counsellor）。
example: Students experiencing exam anxiety are encouraged to make an appointment with the school guidance counsellor.

def_zh: 創業者；企業家
def_en: someone who starts their own business, especially when this involves seeing a new opportunity
prep_trap: Paper 3 高難度拼字：首音節讀似 on- 但必須拼作 en-，中間為 -tre-pre-，字尾為 -neur。
example: A successful young entrepreneur will share practical tips on starting an online business with students.

def_zh: 素食者；素食的
def_en: a person who does not eat meat or fish, or food that does not contain meat
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -ge-tar- 而非 -ge-ter-（veg-e-tar-i-an）；作名詞時可數，作形容詞可修飾 dish/meal。
example: Please indicate on the reply slip whether you require a vegetarian meal for the banquet.

def_zh: 食材；材料；（成功的）要素
def_en: a food that is used with other foods in the preparation of a particular dish
prep_trap: 可數名詞，指食譜材料時通常用複數 ingredients；字尾是 -ent 而非 -ant。
example: The tuition fee covers all fresh ingredients and cooking utensils needed for the baking workshop.

def_zh: 醫生處方；藥方
def_en: a piece of paper on which a doctor writes the details of the medicine someone needs
prep_trap: 注意首音節為 pre-（切勿與意為「看法」的 perception 混淆）；開處方給某人用 a prescription for。
example: Patients cannot purchase antibiotics at local pharmacies without presenting a valid prescription from a doctor.

def_zh: 症狀；徵兆
def_en: any feeling of illness or physical or mental change that is caused by a disease
prep_trap: 注意首音節是 symp-（含 y 及不發音或輕音的 p）；某疾病的症狀介詞用 a symptom of。
example: Anyone showing symptoms of fever or coughing should stay at home and seek medical advice.

def_zh: 衛生；保健
def_en: the degree to which people keep themselves or their environment clean, especially to prevent disease
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，切勿加 -s；注意拼法為 hy-giene（i 在 e 前），切勿與形容詞 hygienic 混淆詞性。
example: Maintaining good personal hygiene is the most effective way to prevent the spread of infectious diseases.

def_zh: 文具；信紙
def_en: the things needed for writing, such as paper, pens, pencils, and envelopes
prep_trap: 不可數名詞（不可說 a stationery 或 stationeries）！注意字尾是 -ery（記法：e 代表 envelope 信封），切勿拼成表示「靜止的」stationary（-ary）。
example: We are collecting donated stationery and textbooks to support underprivileged children in rural areas.

def_zh: 免費贈送的；讚美的
def_en: given free of charge, or expressing admiration and praise
prep_trap: Paper 3 常考「免費贈品/門票」的同義替換！注意中間是 i（com-pli-men-ta-ry），切勿與意為「互補的」complementary（中間是 e）混淆。
example: Every hotel guest will receive a complimentary buffet breakfast and free access to the fitness centre.

def_zh: 可進入的；易到達的；無障礙的
def_en: able to be reached or easily got, or easy for disabled people to enter
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 cc、雙寫 ss，且字尾為 -ible 而非 -able；對某人開放或可達必須搭配介詞 to（accessible to the public）。
example: The newly renovated community centre is fully accessible to wheelchair users and elderly residents.

def_zh: 混雜的；各式各樣的；雜項的
def_en: consisting of a mixture of various things that are not usually connected with each other
prep_trap: Paper 3 財政預算表常考詞（雜項開支 miscellaneous expenses）：注意開頭是 mis-cel-（有 c），中間雙寫 ll，字尾是 -neous。
example: Five hundred dollars has been reserved in our budget to cover miscellaneous expenses such as printing.

def_zh: 津貼；補助；資助金
def_en: money given as part of the cost of something, to help or encourage it to happen
prep_trap: 可數名詞，複數需改 y 為 -ies（subsidies）；注意中間是 -si- 而非 -su-，某項目的津貼用 a subsidy for。
example: Low-income families can apply for a fifty percent travel subsidy to join the summer exchange tour.

def_zh: 贊助商；贊助者；贊助
def_en: a person or organization that gives money to support an activity, event, or charity
prep_trap: 注意字尾為 -sor 而非 -ser（spon-sor）；作及物動詞時直接接受詞（sponsor an event），不需加 for。
example: Several local businesses have agreed to sponsor our annual charity walkathon by donating sports equipment.

def_zh: 贊助；資助款項
def_en: money that is given, usually by a company, to support a person, organization, or activity
prep_trap: 常作不可數名詞；尋求某人的贊助介詞用 seek sponsorship from a company。
example: The student union is currently seeking sponsorship from local bookshops for the upcoming reading week.

def_zh: 報銷；償還；退款
def_en: the act of paying back money to someone who has spent it for you or lost it
prep_trap: Paper 3 Part B 財務信件常考詞：注意拼法為 re-im-burse-ment；申請某開支的報銷介詞用 reimbursement for/of expenses。
example: Please keep all original receipts so that you can claim full reimbursement from the school treasurer.

def_zh: 訂金；押金；按金
def_en: a payment, especially into a bank account, or a sum paid as a first part of a larger payment
prep_trap: 注意字尾無 e（de-pos-it）；支付某項目的訂金介詞搭配 pay a deposit on/for something。
example: Every team must pay a refundable deposit of two hundred dollars when borrowing camping gear.

def_zh: 收據；收到
def_en: a piece of paper which proves that money, goods, or information have been received
prep_trap: 極高頻失分字！遵循 c 後接 ei 原則（re-ceipt），且字尾有完全不發音的 p！切勿與意為「食譜」的 recipe 混淆。
example: Customers must present the original purchase receipt within seven days if they wish to exchange items.

def_zh: 食譜；烹飪法；秘訣
def_en: a set of instructions telling you how to prepare and cook food, including a list of ingredients
prep_trap: 三音節詞（字尾 e 發 /i/ 音），切勿與單音節含 p 的 receipt（收據）混淆；某道菜的食譜用 a recipe for。
example: Participants in the cooking competition are required to submit their original recipe by next Wednesday.

def_zh: 保證；保修期；擔保
def_en: a promise that something will be done or will happen, or a written promise to repair a product
prep_trap: 注意開頭有 u（guar-），中間是 -an-，字尾雙寫 ee；在保修期內固定用 under guarantee。
example: The newly purchased projector comes with a two-year warranty and a full maintenance guarantee.

def_zh: 特權；特別待遇；榮幸
def_en: an advantage that only one person or group of people has, usually because of their position
prep_trap: 極高頻拼錯字！中間是兩個 i（priv-i-），字尾是 -lege（絕對沒有 d，切勿受 knowledge 影響拼成 priviledge）。
example: Gold card members can enjoy exclusive privileges such as priority booking for all annual workshops.

def_zh: 時間表；日程；安排時間
def_en: a list of planned activities or things to be done showing the times or dates when they are intended to happen
prep_trap: 注意開頭為 sch-（sched-ule）；按時進行用 on schedule，落後進度用 behind schedule，預定於某時用 be scheduled for/to。
example: The rehearsal is scheduled for this Saturday morning from nine to twelve in the music room.

def_zh: 日曆；月曆；行事曆
def_en: a printed table showing all the days, weeks, and months of the year
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -en-，字尾是 -dar 而非 -der（cal-en-dar）；在校曆表上用 on the school calendar。
example: Please mark the dates of the mock examinations clearly on your personal study calendar.

def_zh: 同事；同僚
def_en: one of a group of people who work together in the same organization or profession
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 ll，且字尾為 -eague（col-league），切勿與意為「大學/學院」的 college 混淆！
example: I would like to thank my colleagues in the English Department for their generous support.

def_zh: 全體人員；職員；人事部門
def_en: the people who are employed in a company, organization, or one of the armed forces
prep_trap: 集合名詞（不加 -s）：注意雙寫 nn、單寫 l（per-son-nel），重音在尾音節；切勿與形容詞 personal（個人的）混淆。
example: Only authorized personnel and registered student helpers are allowed to enter the backstage storage area.

def_zh: 助理；助手；副的
def_en: someone who helps someone else to do a job
prep_trap: 注意前雙寫 ss、後單寫 s，字尾是 -ant 而非 -ent（as-sis-tant）；某人的助理用 an assistant to sb。
example: Interested applicants should send their resumes directly to the administrative assistant by Friday afternoon.

def_zh: 服務員；接待員；隨從
def_en: someone whose job is to be in a place and help visitors or customers
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 tt，字尾為 -ant（指服務人員，如 flight attendant），切勿與名詞 attendance（出席率）混淆。
example: If you lose any personal belongings, please report to the cloakroom attendant near the main entrance.

def_zh: 參加者；參與者
def_en: a person who takes part in or becomes involved in a particular activity
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -tic-i-，字尾為 -pant（a），切勿拼成 -pent；某活動的參加者介詞用 a participant in an event。
example: Each participant in the marathon will receive a digital timing chip and an event T-shirt.

def_zh: 申請人；應徵者
def_en: a person who formally requests something, especially a job, or a place at college
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 pp，y 轉 i，字尾為 -cant；申請某職位或獎學金的人介詞用 an applicant for the post。
example: Only shortlisted applicants will be invited to attend an individual selection interview next Tuesday.

def_zh: 考生；候選人；應徵者
def_en: a person who is competing to get a job or elected position, or who is taking an exam
prep_trap: 注意第一個 d 不可漏寫（can-di-date）；某職位的候選人介詞用 a candidate for。
example: All examination candidates must arrive at the test centre at least thirty minutes before the start.

def_zh: 業餘愛好者；業餘的
def_en: taking part in an activity for pleasure, not as a job
prep_trap: 注意中間是 a（am-a-），字尾為法文借詞拼法 -teur（e 在 u 前），切勿拼成 -ture。
example: The wildlife photography competition is open to all local secondary school students and amateur photographers.

def_zh: 專業的；職業的；專業人士
def_en: relating to work that needs special training or education, or a person who has this training
prep_trap: 極易拼錯 f 與 s 的數量：記住「單 f 雙 ss」（pro-fes-sion-al），切勿寫成雙 ff。
example: A professional drama coach will lead three practical acting workshops for our club members.

def_zh: 義工；志願者；自願做
def_en: a person who does something, especially helping other people, willingly and without being paid
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -un-（vol-un-teer）；自願做某事用 volunteer to do sth，為某機構做義工用 volunteer for/with。
example: We need to recruit at least twenty student volunteers to help set up the game booths.

def_zh: 自願的；義務的；無償的
def_en: done, made, or given willingly, without being forced or paid to do it
prep_trap: 形容詞（切勿與名詞 volunteer 混淆詞性）：注意中間是 -un-，字尾是 -tary（a）；在自願基礎上用 on a voluntary basis。
example: Participation in the weekend coastal clean-up campaign is completely voluntary for all Form Four students.

def_zh: 強制的；必修的；必須做的
def_en: that must be done because of a rule or law
prep_trap: Paper 3 核心替換詞（對應錄音中的 must / have to）：注意中間是 -pul-so-ry（s 而非 c）；對某人而言是強制性的用 compulsory for sb。
example: Attending the safety briefing session this Friday is compulsory for all participants joining the camp.

def_zh: 強制性的；法定的；必做的
def_en: something that is mandatory must be done, or is demanded by law or official rules
prep_trap: 注意拼法為 man-da-to-ry（a 及 o）；常與句型 It is mandatory for sb to do sth 搭配。
example: Wearing a life jacket is strictly mandatory for everyone taking part in the kayaking activity.

def_zh: 可選擇的；選修的；非強制的
def_en: if something is optional, you can choose if you want to do it, pay it, or buy it
prep_trap: compulsory 的反義詞（對應錄音中的 up to you / don't have to）；注意由 option 加 -al 構成。
example: The afternoon sightseeing tour of the museum is optional and costs an extra fifty dollars.

def_zh: 有資格的；符合條件的
def_en: having the necessary qualities or satisfying the necessary conditions to receive or do something
prep_trap: 注意開頭是 e（el-i-gi-ble，切勿與意為「字跡難辨的」illegible 混淆）；後接名詞用 eligible for，接動詞用 eligible to do。
example: Full-time students aged under eighteen are eligible for a half-price discount on admission tickets.

def_zh: 可獲得的；可用的；有空的
def_en: able to be bought or used, or not busy and therefore free to talk to people
prep_trap: 極易拼錯中間的 ai 及字尾 -able（a-vail-a-ble，切勿寫成 avaliable）；供某人使用介詞用 available to sb，在某處提供用 available at/in。
example: Application forms are now available for download on the official school website until next Monday.

def_zh: 方便的；便利的；就近的
def_en: suitable for your purposes and needs and causing the least difficulty
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -ve-ni-ent（i 在 e 前，切勿拼成 convinent）；主語不可是「人」（不可說 I am convenient），必須說 It is convenient for sb。
example: Please let us know whether Tuesday afternoon is a convenient time for your interview.

def_zh: 環境；自然環境
def_en: the air, water, and land in or on which people, animals, and plants live
prep_trap: DSE 萬年高頻拼錯字！ment 前面必須有 n（en-vi-ron-ment），切勿因發音弱化而漏寫 n！指自然環境時必加 the（the environment）。
example: Our school aims to create a supportive and stress-free learning environment for all students.

def_zh: 政府；政體
def_en: the group of people who officially control a country or region
prep_trap: 與 environment 一樣，ment 前面必須有 n（gov-ern-ment），切勿寫成 goverment！
example: The community group received a special grant from the government to organize youth sports programmes.

def_zh: 設備；器材；裝備
def_en: the set of necessary tools, clothing, etc. for a particular purpose
prep_trap: 絕對不可數名詞！永遠不可加 -s（不可寫 equipments）或加 a；表一件器材用 a piece of equipment。
example: All necessary camping and cooking equipment will be provided free of charge by the Youth Centre.

def_zh: 資訊；資料；消息
def_en: facts about a situation, person, event, etc.
prep_trap: 絕對不可數名詞（切勿寫 informations 或 an information）；注意中間是 -for-；關於某事的資訊介詞用 information on/about。
example: For further information regarding the summer internship programme, please contact Miss Chan at the office.

def_zh: 行李
def_en: the bags, suitcases, etc. that contain your possessions and that you take with you when you are travelling
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，切勿加 -s（不可寫 luggages）；注意雙寫 gg；一件行李用 a piece of luggage。
example: Each passenger is allowed to carry one piece of hand luggage onto the tour coach.

def_zh: 意見反映；回饋；反饋
def_en: information or statements of opinion about something, such as a new product, that can tell you if it is successful
prep_trap: 絕對不可數名詞，切勿加 -s（不可寫 feedbacks）！對某事的意見介詞必須用 feedback on（而非 to）。
example: We have received overwhelmingly positive feedback from parents on last week's Open Day activities.

def_zh: 建議；忠告；意見
def_en: an opinion that someone offers you about what you should do or how you should act in a particular situation
prep_trap: 不可數名詞（不可寫 advices），注意字尾為 c（名詞）而非 s（動詞 advise）；關於某事的建議介詞用 advice on。
example: Two alumni will attend the seminar to offer practical advice on preparing for university interviews.

def_zh: 建議；勸告；通知
def_en: to give someone official information about something, or tell them what you think they should do
prep_trap: 動詞（字尾為 s，讀 /z/ 音）：句型為 advise sb to do sth（與 suggest 不可接 sb to do 剛好相反！）。
example: Participants are strongly advised to bring a waterproof jacket and plenty of drinking water tomorrow.

def_zh: 練習；實踐；慣例
def_en: action rather than thought or ideas, or regular training to improve your skill at something
prep_trap: 香港 DSE 採英式標準：c 為名詞（practice），s 為動詞（practise）；付諸實踐固定用 put into practice。
example: Choir practice will be held every Tuesday and Thursday after school in the music room.

def_zh: 練習；訓練；實行
def_en: to do or play something regularly or repeatedly in order to become skilled at it
prep_trap: 動詞（字尾為 s）：若後接動詞，必須使用動名詞 V-ing（practise speaking English），絕對不可接 to do！
example: Joining the English Café is a wonderful opportunity for students to practise speaking with native speakers.

def_zh: 牌照；執照；許可證
def_en: an official document that gives you permission to own, do, or use something
prep_trap: 英式拼法中 c 為名詞（li-cence），s 為動詞（license）；可數名詞，指駕駛執照為 a driving licence。
example: Applicants for the delivery driver position must hold a valid Hong Kong driving licence.

def_zh: 靜止的；固定的；不移動的
def_en: not moving, or not intended to be moved
prep_trap: 極易與名詞 stationery（文具，字尾 -ery）混淆！形容詞 stationary 字尾為 -ary（記法：a 代表 a parked car）。
example: Passengers must remain seated until the shuttle bus comes to a completely stationary position.

def_zh: 互補的；相輔相成的
def_en: useful or attractive together because they have different qualities that improve each other
prep_trap: 注意中間是 e（com-ple-men-ta-ry，源自 complete），切勿與意為「免費贈送的」complimentary（中間是 i）混淆；與某事物互補介詞用 to。
example: Online learning platforms and traditional classroom teaching play complementary roles in modern secondary education.

def_zh: 校長；主要的；最重要的
def_en: the person in charge of a school or college for children, or first in order of importance
prep_trap: Paper 3 必考同音陷阱：指「校長」或「主要的」字尾必須為 -pal（記法：校長是你的 pal 朋友），切勿拼成 principle（原則）。
example: Our school principal will deliver a welcoming speech at the beginning of the graduation ceremony.

def_zh: 原則；原理；信條
def_en: a basic idea or rule that explains or controls how something happens or works
prep_trap: 只作名詞，字尾為 -ple（如同 rule），切勿與指校長的 principal 混淆；大體上/原則上固定搭配為 in principle。
example: The workshop will introduce students to the basic principles of financial management and budgeting.

def_zh: 舉辦地點；場地；會場
def_en: the place where a public event or meeting happens
prep_trap: Paper 3 活動海報與通告必考詞：注意拼法為 ven-ue；某活動的場地介詞用 the venue for an event。
example: Please note that the venue for tomorrow's debate competition has been changed to Room 302.

def_zh: 入場；入場費；錄取
def_en: permission to enter a place, or the money that you pay to enter a place
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 ss（ad-mis-sion）；准許進入某處或某展覽的門票，後面介詞必須用 to（admission to the museum）。
example: Admission to the annual book fair is completely free for children aged below twelve.

def_zh: 容納；提供住宿；配合（需求）
def_en: to provide with a place to live or to have enough space for a particular number of people
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 cc 及雙寫 mm（ac-com-mo-date）；及物動詞，直接接人數或需求（accommodate up to 200 guests），不需加 for。
example: The newly built lecture theatre can comfortably accommodate up to three hundred students at once.

def_zh: 容量；容納人數；能力
def_en: the total amount that can be contained or produced, or the ability to do something
prep_trap: 注意中間是 c（ca-pac-i-ty）；表示「全場爆滿/達到最高容量」固定用 at full capacity。
example: The school hall has a maximum seating capacity of five hundred people for the concert.

def_zh: 預訂；預約；保留意見
def_en: an arrangement in which something such as a seat on an aircraft or a table at a restaurant is kept for you
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -ser-（res-er-va-tion）；進行預訂搭配動詞 make（make a reservation），取消預訂用 cancel。
example: Please call the restaurant before Friday to confirm our table reservation for the graduation dinner.

def_zh: 取消；退訂
def_en: the act of deciding that an organized event will not happen or of stopping an order
prep_trap: 英式拼法需雙寫 ll（can-cel-la-tion）；如在活動前取消，常用 in the event of cancellation。
example: In the event of bad weather, any notice of cancellation will be posted on our website.

def_zh: 延期；押後；推遲
def_en: a delay to a planned event until a later date or time
prep_trap: 注意第一個 t 雖不完全爆破但必須寫出（post-pone-ment），切勿漏寫 t 或 e！
example: We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by the sudden postponement of the sports day.

def_zh: 準時的；守時的
def_en: arriving, doing something, or happening at the expected, correct time; not late
prep_trap: 注意中間有 c（punc-tu-al，源自 point）；對某事守時介詞搭配 be punctual for the meeting。
example: All helpers are reminded to be punctual for the morning briefing session at eight o'clock.

def_zh: 準時；守時
def_en: the fact or quality of being on time
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，注意中間有 c（punc-tu-al-i-ty）。
example: The camp rules emphasize the importance of punctuality and teamwork during all outdoor group activities.

def_zh: 持續時間；期間
def_en: the length of time that something lasts
prep_trap: Paper 3 表格常考欄目（Duration: 2 hours）：在整個活動期間固定搭配為 for the duration of。
example: Mobile phones must be switched to silent mode for the entire duration of the performance.

def_zh: 中場休息；間隔時間
def_en: a period between two events or times, or a short break between the parts of a play or concert
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -ter-，字尾是 -val（a）而非 -vel；在中場休息期間介詞用 during the interval，每隔一段時間用 at regular intervals。
example: There will be a fifteen-minute interval between the first and second halves of the concert.

def_zh: 綵排；排練
def_en: a time when all the people involved in a play, dance, etc. practise in order to prepare for a performance
prep_trap: 極高頻拼錯字！中間包含 hear（聽），再加 -sal（re-hears-al）；切勿漏寫 a 或將字尾拼成 -sel。
example: All cast members must wear their full costumes for the final dress rehearsal this Friday.

def_zh: 試鏡；試音；面試表演
def_en: a short performance that an actor, musician, dancer, etc. gives in order to show they are suitable for a play or concert
prep_trap: 注意開頭為 au-（與聲音 audio 同源）；為某角色試鏡介詞必須用 audition for a role。
example: Students who wish to audition for the school musical should sign up outside the music room.

def_zh: 表演；演出；表現（如學業表現）
def_en: the action of entertaining other people by dancing, singing, acting, or playing music, or how well someone does a job
prep_trap: 注意開頭是 per- 而非 pre-，字尾是 -ance 而非 -ence（per-form-ance）！指「演出」時可數，指「工作/學業表現」時常作不可數。
example: The drama club will put on a special charity performance to raise funds for the hospital.

def_zh: 出席；到場；出席人數
def_en: the fact of going somewhere such as a church, school, etc. regularly, or the number of people present
prep_trap: 不可數名詞：注意雙寫 tt，字尾是 -ance（at-tend-ance），切勿拼成 -ence；點名用 take attendance。
example: Class teachers will take attendance at the entrance of the theatre before the talk begins.

def_zh: 缺席；不在；缺乏
def_en: the fact of not being where you are usually expected to be
prep_trap: 極高頻拼錯字！中間是 s，字尾是 -ce（ab-sence，切勿拼成 absense）；缺席某課堂介詞用 absence from school。
example: Students must submit a parent's letter to explain their absence from the examination yesterday.

def_zh: 准許；許可；同意
def_en: if someone is given permission to do something, they are allowed to do it
prep_trap: 不可數名詞（不可說 a permission）！注意雙寫 ss；獲准做某事用 get/obtain permission to do sth。
example: Participants under eighteen must obtain written parental permission before joining the overnight camping trip.

def_zh: 批准；認可；贊成
def_en: official permission or agreement for a plan, request, or decision
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，注意雙寫 pp，去 e 加 -al（ap-prov-al）；須經某人批准固定用 subject to the approval of。
example: All proposed budget items are subject to the final approval of the school principal.

def_zh: 簽名；署名
def_en: your name written by yourself, always in the same way, usually to show that something has been written or agreed by you
prep_trap: 可數名詞（切勿將動詞 sign 直接當作名詞「簽名」用！）；注意中間有 a（sig-na-ture）。
example: Please return the completed reply slip with your parent's signature to your class teacher tomorrow.

def_zh: 電話分機；延期；擴建部分
def_en: an extra telephone line connected to a central system, or extra time given to complete something
prep_trap: Paper 3 聽電話題必考（如 extension 2408）：注意字尾為 -sion 而非 -tion（ex-ten-sion）。
example: For enquiries, please call the general office and ask for Miss Wong on extension 304.

def_zh: 電話簿；名錄；指南
def_en: a book or list of names, addresses, telephone numbers, facts, etc., usually arranged in alphabetical order
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -to-ry 而非 -ta-ry；複數為 directories。
example: You can find the contact email of every teacher in the online staff directory.

def_zh: 查詢；詢問；調查
def_en: a question that you ask in order to get information about something
prep_trap: Paper 3 信件結尾萬用詞（亦作 inquiry）：複數必須改 y 為 -ies（enquiries）！注意動詞 enquire 變名詞時去 e 加 -y（無 e）。
example: Should you have any further enquiries, please feel free to contact me at any time.

def_zh: 投訴；抱怨；不滿
def_en: a statement that something is wrong or not satisfactory
prep_trap: 極高頻詞性混淆！動詞是 complain（無 t），名詞「投訴」必須在字尾加 t（com-plaint）！提出投訴用 make/lodge a complaint about。
example: The management office has received several complaints from residents about excessive noise at night.

def_zh: 道歉；謝罪
def_en: a word or statement saying sorry for something that has been done wrong or that causes a problem
prep_trap: 可數名詞，信件中常作複數（Please accept our sincere apologies）；為某事道歉介詞用 an apology for。
example: Please accept our sincere apologies for the delay in delivering your ordered school uniforms.

def_zh: 感激；感謝；欣賞
def_en: to recognize how good someone or something is and to value them, or to feel grateful
prep_trap: 語法大伏！appreciate 後面的受詞必須是「事情/協助」（I appreciate your help），絕對不可直接接「人」（不可說 I appreciate you）！若接子句必須加 it（I would appreciate it if you could...）。
example: We would greatly appreciate it if you could reply to this invitation by next Monday.

def_zh: 感激的；感謝的
def_en: showing or expressing thanks, especially to another person
prep_trap: 極高頻拼錯字！字根是 grate-（有 e，切勿受 great 影響拼成 greatful），字尾是單 l（-ful）；對某人感激用 grateful to sb，對某事感激用 grateful for sth。
example: I would be extremely grateful if you could grant us permission to use the hall.

def_zh: 真誠地；誠懇地（信件結尾敬語）
def_en: honestly and without pretending or lying; used to end formal letters when you know the person's name
prep_trap: 公函下款必備！中間必須保留 e（sin-cere-ly，切勿拼成 sincerly）；只有上款有名有姓（如 Dear Mr Chan）才可用 Yours sincerely。
example: We sincerely hope that you will be able to attend our annual prize-giving ceremony.

def_zh: 忠實地；誠摯地（匿名公函結尾敬語）
def_en: in a loyal way; used at the end of a formal letter beginning with 'Dear Sir or Madam'
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 ll（faith-ful-ly）；當公函上款為 Dear Sir/Madam 或 Dear Editor（不知收信人姓名）時，下款必須配 Yours faithfully。
example: When writing a formal letter to the editor, remember to sign off with Yours faithfully.

def_zh: （電郵）附件；附屬物；依戀
def_en: a computer file which is sent together with an email message
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 tt（at-tach-ment）；電郵中指附件為 an email attachment，紙本信件中的附件則多用 enclosure。
example: I have sent the revised budget proposal and floor plan as an email attachment.

def_zh: （信件）附件；隨函附上的文件；圍場
def_en: a document or object that is put inside an envelope with a letter
prep_trap: 注意由動詞 enclose 去 e 加 -ure 構成（en-clo-sure）；在實體信件中常以過去分詞 enclosed 出現（Please find enclosed...）。
example: Please find enclosed a copy of the event poster and three complimentary admission tickets.

def_zh: 機密的；保密的
def_en: secret, often in a formal, business, or military situation
prep_trap: 注意字尾是 -tial 而非 -cial（con-fi-den-tial，源自 confident）；保持機密常用 keep sth strictly confidential。
example: All personal data collected in this survey will be kept strictly confidential and destroyed afterwards.

def_zh: 匿名的；不具名的
def_en: made or done by someone whose name is not known or not made public
prep_trap: 高難度拼字：注意中間有 y（a-non-y-mous），字尾是 -mous；保持匿名用 remain anonymous。
example: The online survey is completely anonymous so students can express their honest opinions freely.

def_zh: 陪同；陪伴；伴隨
def_en: to go with someone or to be provided or exist at the same time as something
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 cc（ac-com-pa-ny）；及物動詞，直接接人（accompany a child），切勿畫蛇添足加 with！被動語態才用 be accompanied by an adult。
example: Children under the age of twelve must be accompanied by an adult at all times.

def_zh: 確認收到（信件）；承認；致謝
def_en: to accept, admit, or recognize something, or to tell someone that you have received something they sent you
prep_trap: 注意開頭是 ac- 加 knowl-edge（有 d，與 privilege 相反）；公函開頭常用 acknowledge receipt of your letter（確認收悉來信）。
example: I am writing to acknowledge receipt of your application for the summer internship programme.

def_zh: 澄清；說明；解釋
def_en: an explanation or more details that makes something clearer and easier to understand
prep_trap: 動詞為 clarify，變名詞時去 y 加 -fication（clar-i-fi-ca-tion）；尋求關於某事的澄清介詞用 seek clarification on/of。
example: I am writing to seek further clarification on the safety arrangements for the outdoor camp.

def_zh: 確認；證實；確認書
def_en: a statement, often in writing, that an arrangement or meeting is certain
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -fir- 而非 -fer-（con-fir-ma-tion，源自 confirm）；收到某事的確認信介詞用 confirmation of。
example: Successful applicants will receive an email confirmation within three working days after submitting the form.

def_zh: 通知；通告；通知書
def_en: the act of telling someone officially about something, or a document that does this
prep_trap: 動詞為 notify，變名詞時 y 轉 i 加 -cation（no-ti-fi-ca-tion）；事先通知固定搭配為 prior notification。
example: Parents will receive an official notification via the school mobile app if classes are suspended.

def_zh: 規格；詳述；要求細則
def_en: a detailed description of how something should be done, made, or designed
prep_trap: Paper 3 採購或設計項目常作複數（specifications）；符合某人的規格要求用 meet the specifications。
example: The printing company promised that the posters would be produced according to our exact specifications.

def_zh: 資歷；學歷；專業資格
def_en: an official record showing that you have finished a training course or have the necessary skills
prep_trap: 指學歷或專業資格時必須用複數 qualifications；具備某職位的資格介詞用 qualifications for the job。
example: Applicants should list their academic qualifications and relevant working experience clearly on the application form.

def_zh: 要求；必要條件；規定
def_en: something that you must do, or something you need in order to be accepted
prep_trap: 注意中間必須保留不發音的 e（re-quire-ment）！符合要求固定搭配動詞 meet / fulfil / satisfy the requirements。
example: All applicants must meet the minimum language requirements before applying for the overseas exchange programme.

def_zh: 先決條件；必備前提
def_en: something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen
prep_trap: 注意拼法為 pre-req-ui-site；某事的先決條件後面介詞必須用 for 或 to（a prerequisite for joining）。
example: Passing the basic swimming test is an essential prerequisite for joining the advanced canoeing course.

def_zh: （評審或篩選的）標準；準則（單數）
def_en: a standard by which you judge, decide about, or deal with something
prep_trap: DSE 閱卷高頻單複數陷阱！criterion 是單數，其複數形式是 criteria（切勿寫成 criterions 或把 criteria 當單數用！）。
example: Originality is the most important judging criterion in the inter-school short film competition.

def_zh: （評審或篩選的）多項標準；準則（複數）
def_en: plural of criterion: standards used for judging or making a decision
prep_trap: 本身已是複數名詞（絕對不可再加 -s 寫成 criterias）！後接動詞必須用複數（The judging criteria are...）。
example: The selection criteria for the scholarship include academic excellence, leadership skills, and community service.

def_zh: （學校的）全部課程
def_en: the subjects studied in a school, college, etc. and what each subject includes
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 rr（cur-ric-u-lum）；在學校課程中納入某科介詞用 in/on the school curriculum。
example: Many educators suggest integrating mental health education into the core secondary school curriculum.

def_zh: 課外的（活動）
def_en: an extracurricular activity or subject is not part of the usual school or college course
prep_trap: 極高頻拼錯字！注意雙寫 rr，且字尾為形容詞後綴 -lar（ex-tra-cur-ric-u-lar），切勿將名詞 curriculum 直接放進 extracurricular activities！
example: Participating in extracurricular activities helps students develop interpersonal skills beyond the traditional classroom.

def_zh: 評核；評估；考核
def_en: the act of judging or deciding the amount, value, quality, or importance of something
prep_trap: 極易漏寫雙 s：總共有兩組雙 ss（as-sess-ment）！校本評核即 School-based Assessment (SBA)。
example: The final grade for the course is based on continuous assessment and a written examination.

def_zh: 評估；檢討；評價
def_en: the process of judging or calculating the quality, importance, amount, or value of something
prep_trap: Paper 3 活動檢討報告（Evaluation Report）必用詞：注意由 value 衍生，去 e 加 -ation（e-val-u-a-tion）。
example: The organizing committee will hold an evaluation meeting next week to review the event's success.

def_zh: 建議；推薦；推薦信
def_en: a suggestion that something is good or suitable for a particular purpose, or a piece of advice
prep_trap: DSE 報告結尾標題必考字！切記「單 c 雙 mm」（rec-om-men-da-tion），千萬不可寫成雙 cc！且與 suggestion 一樣是可數名詞（常加 -s）。
example: Based on the survey findings, our team would like to make three practical recommendations.

def_zh: 建議；提議；意見
def_en: an idea, plan, or action that is suggested or the act of suggesting it
prep_trap: 與不可數的 advice 相反，suggestion 是可數名詞，必須加 a 或複數 -s（some suggestions）！注意雙寫 gg。
example: We welcome any constructive suggestions from students on how to improve the library facilities.

def_zh: 計劃書；建議書；提議
def_en: a suggestion, sometimes a written one, for a future course of action
prep_trap: Paper 3 三大文體之一（Proposal）：注意由動詞 propose 去 e 加 -al 構成（pro-pos-al）；某項目的計劃書介詞用 a proposal for/on。
example: I am writing to submit a proposal for organizing a Green Week on campus next month.

def_zh: 目標；宗旨；客觀的
def_en: something that you plan to do or achieve, or based on real facts and not influenced by personal feelings
prep_trap: 計劃書首段必用詞（可數名詞）：達成目標搭配動詞 achieve / meet / fulfil the objectives。
example: The primary objective of this campaign is to raise students' awareness of cyber safety.

def_zh: 新措施；倡議；主動性
def_en: a new plan or process to achieve something or solve a problem, or the ability to use your judgment to make decisions
prep_trap: 高分替換 plan / activity 的神字！注意拼法有兩個 ti（i-ni-ti-a-tive）；推行新措施用 launch a new initiative，採取主動用 take the initiative。
example: The student union has launched a new recycling initiative to reduce plastic waste at school.

def_zh: 宣傳運動；大型活動；發起運動
def_en: a planned group of especially political, business, or military activities that are intended to achieve a particular aim
prep_trap: 極高頻拼錯字！字尾有不發音的 g，且 g 在 n 前（cam-paign，如同 sign / design），切勿拼成 campain 或 campaing！
example: Our club will launch a two-week fundraising campaign to support victims of the recent earthquake.

def_zh: 錦標賽；聯賽
def_en: a competition for teams or single players in which a series of games is played, and the winners of each game play against each other
prep_trap: 注意首音節是 tour-（有 u），中間是 -na-（tour-na-ment）；用於球類或棋類等多輪淘汰賽。
example: Sixteen teams have registered to compete in the annual inter-house badminton tournament next month.

def_zh: 冠軍賽；錦標賽；冠軍頭銜
def_en: a high-level competition to decide who is the best, especially in a sport
prep_trap: 注意由 champion 加 -ship 構成。
example: Our school swimming team won the overall championship at the inter-school aquatic meet yesterday.

def_zh: 宴會；盛宴；晚宴
def_en: a large formal meal for many people, often followed by speeches in honour of someone
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -quet（讀 /kwɪt/ 或 /kwet/），切勿與意為「花束」的 bouquet 混淆。
example: The annual alumni banquet will be held at a five-star hotel in Tsim Sha Tsui.

def_zh: 典禮；儀式
def_en: a set of formal acts, often fixed and traditional, performed on important social or religious occasions
prep_trap: 注意首兩音節是 cer-e-（都是 e，切勿拼成 ceromony）；複數為 ceremonies。
example: All awardees must wear full school uniform when attending the annual prize-giving ceremony tomorrow.

def_zh: 專題研討會；學術座談會
def_en: an occasion at which people who have great knowledge of a particular subject meet in order to discuss a matter of interest
prep_trap: 注意首音節有 y（sym-po-si-um）；關於某議題的研討會介詞用 a symposium on。
example: Five senior students were selected to represent our school at the Youth Leadership Symposium.

def_zh: 講座；研討課；專題討論會
def_en: an occasion when a teacher or expert and a group of people meet to study and discuss something
prep_trap: 注意字尾是 -nar（ar）而非 -ner（sem-i-nar）；關於某主題的講座介詞用 a seminar on。
example: The Careers Committee will host a seminar on university admissions this Friday in the hall.

def_zh: 迎新會；迎新培訓；方向定位
def_en: training or preparation for a new job, school, or activity
prep_trap: Paper 3 校園迎新題必考詞：注意中間是 -ri-en-（o-ri-en-ta-tion）；常作定語修飾 day / camp / session。
example: All incoming Secondary One students and their parents are invited to attend Orientation Day.

def_zh: 嘉年華會；遊藝會
def_en: a public festival or event with music, games, and entertainment
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -ni-，字尾是 -val（car-ni-val，切勿拼成 carnivel）。
example: The English Society will set up three interactive game booths at the annual charity carnival.

def_zh: 義賣會；市集
def_en: a sale of goods, especially handmade ones, to raise money for charity
prep_trap: Paper 3 慈善活動高難度拼字：單 z 雙 aa（ba-zaar），切勿拼成 bazzar（雙 z）或與意為「怪異的」bizarre 混淆！
example: All proceeds from the Christmas charity bazaar will be donated to the local children's hospital.

def_zh: 馬拉松賽跑；耐力活動
def_en: a running race of slightly over 26 miles (42.195 kilometres), or a long activity requiring great effort
prep_trap: 注意前兩個元音都是 a，最後一個元音是 o（mar-a-thon），切勿拼成 marothon。
example: Over two hundred teachers and students have signed up for the ten-kilometre charity marathon.

def_zh: 慈善步行籌款活動
def_en: an event in which people walk a long distance in order to raise money for a charity
prep_trap: 香港學校籌款活動常考詞：由 walk + a + thon 構成（walk-a-thon），中間是 a 而非 o。
example: Each student participating in the annual walkathon must raise at least one hundred dollars.

def_zh: 短途旅行；校外考察；遠足
def_en: a short journey usually made for pleasure, often by a group of people
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -cur-，字尾是 -sion（ex-cur-sion）；去某地的考察旅行介詞用 an excursion to。
example: The Geography Department has organized a half-day educational excursion to the Hong Kong Geopark.

def_zh: 探險；遠征；戶外考察之旅
def_en: an organized journey for a particular purpose, especially to a place that is not well known
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -pe-di-tion；進行探險考察搭配動詞 go on / undertake an expedition。
example: Members of the hiking club will go on a two-day camping expedition in Sai Kung.

def_zh: 涼亭；展覽館；體育館看台
def_en: a building in a park or garden that is used for shelter or entertainment, or a large temporary building at an exhibition
prep_trap: Paper 3 地圖及公園設施常考詞：注意中間是單寫 l（pa-vil-ion，與 million 雙 ll 不同！）。
example: In case of sudden rain, hikers can take shelter at the wooden pavilion near the summit.

def_zh: 走廊；通道
def_en: a long passage in a building or train, especially with rooms on either side
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 rr，字尾是 -dor 而非 -der（cor-ri-dor）；在走廊上介詞用 in the corridor。
example: Students are strictly prohibited from running or playing ball games in the school corridors.

def_zh: （學校、機構或商鋪的）場地；處所；樓宇範圍
def_en: the land and buildings owned by someone, especially by a company or organization
prep_trap: 指「場地/處所」時永遠以複數形式 premises 出現！在學校或處所範圍內，介詞必須用 on the premises。
example: Smoking and eating are strictly forbidden anywhere on the library premises at all times.

def_zh: 行人；步行者；行人的
def_en: a person who is walking, especially in an area where vehicles go
prep_trap: 注意前兩音節是 pe-des-（兩個 e），字尾是 -trian；行人專用區為 pedestrian zone。
example: Participants will distribute charity flags to pedestrians outside the MTR station this Saturday morning.

def_zh: 目的地；終點
def_en: the place where someone is going or where something is being sent or taken
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -ti-（des-ti-na-tion）；到達目的地搭配動詞 reach / arrive at our destination。
example: It will take approximately forty-five minutes by coach to reach our campsite destination.

def_zh: 出發；啟程；離境
def_en: the fact of a person or vehicle, etc. leaving somewhere
prep_trap: Paper 3 行程表必考（Departure time / Assembly point）：由 depart 加 -ure 構成（de-par-ture）。
example: All tour participants must gather at the school car park fifteen minutes before departure.

def_zh: 交通工具；運輸；接送安排
def_en: a system of vehicles, such as buses and trains, for getting from one place to another
prep_trap: 不可數名詞（不可加 -s）；注意中間是 -por-（trans-por-ta-tion）；提供往返某地的交通接送用 provide transportation to and from。
example: Free coach transportation to and from the campsite will be arranged for all registered participants.

def_zh: 穿梭巴士；接駁交通工具
def_en: a vehicle or aircraft that travels regularly between two places
prep_trap: Paper 3 交通安排必考詞：注意雙寫 tt（shut-tle），切勿與羽毛球的 shuttlecock 混淆；常作定語修飾 bus / service。
example: A complimentary shuttle bus will run between the MTR station and the exhibition centre every fifteen minutes.

def_zh: 早會；集會；集合地點（作定語）
def_en: a regular meeting of all the teachers and students in a school, or the process of coming together
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 ss（as-sem-bly）；Paper 3 行程表常考「集合時間/集合地點」：Assembly time / Assembly point。
example: All students must gather at the designated assembly point in the playground by eight o'clock sharp.

def_zh: 放學；解散；解僱
def_en: the act of allowing students to leave school, or the act of removing someone from their job
prep_trap: 注意前單 s、後雙寫 ss，字尾加 -al（dis-mis-sal）；Paper 3 活動時間表常考「解散時間/地點」：Dismissal time / Dismissal point。
example: The dismissal time for the summer leadership day camp is five o'clock at the Kowloon Tong station.

def_zh: 準時地；守時地
def_en: at the expected, correct time; not late
prep_trap: 注意中間有 c 且字尾雙寫 ll（punc-tu-al-ly）；用來修飾動詞 arrive / start / depart。
example: The tour coach will depart punctually at nine o'clock, so latecomers will not be waited for.

def_zh: 同時地；同步地
def_en: in a way that happens or is done at the exact same time
prep_trap: Paper 3 整合改寫高分詞（替換錄音中的 at the same time）：注意中間是 -ul-ta-ne-ous-ly。
example: Two different workshops will be held simultaneously in the art room and the computer room.

def_zh: 連續地；不間斷地
def_en: in a way that follows one after another without an interruption
basic_word: in a row / back to back
prep_trap: 注意形容詞為 consecutive（con-sec-u-tive，對應錄音中的 three days in a row -> three consecutive days）。
example: Our school choir has won the gold award in the music festival for three years consecutively.

def_zh: 暫定的；初步的；未最終確定的
def_en: of a plan or arrangement: not certain or fixed, and may be changed later
prep_trap: Paper 3 計劃書與日程表必考詞（Tentative schedule）：注意中間是 -ta- 而非 -ti-（ten-ta-tive）。
example: Below is the tentative schedule for the orientation camp, which is still subject to final confirmation.

def_zh: 臨時的；暫定的
def_en: for the present time but likely to change later; temporary
prep_trap: 由名詞 provision 加 -al 構成（pro-vi-sion-al）；暫定預訂為 provisional booking。
example: I have made a provisional booking at the community hall for the first Saturday of November.

def_zh: 每年的；一年一度的；年度的
def_en: happening once every year, or relating to a period of one year
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 nn（an-nu-al），切勿拼成 anual；對應錄音中的 every year / once a year。
example: All parents are cordially invited to attend our school's annual athletic meet next Friday.

def_zh: 一年兩次的；半年一度的
def_en: happening twice a year
prep_trap: Paper 3 聽力大陷阱！bi-an-nu-al 指「一年兩次」（twice a year），而 biennial（bi-en-ni-al）才是指「兩年一次」（every two years）！
example: The editorial board publishes a biannual school newsletter in January and July every year.

def_zh: 每兩週一次的（地）；雙週的
def_en: happening or produced once every two weeks
prep_trap: 英式及香港 DSE 聽力極常考！a fortnight = two weeks（十四天），注意中間是 night（fort-night-ly）。
example: Regular club meetings will be held fortnightly on alternate Wednesdays after school in Room 204.

def_zh: 每季度的（地）；每三個月一次的
def_en: done or produced four times a year, every three months
prep_trap: 注意首音節是 quar-ter-（有 r），對應錄音中的 every three months 或 four times a year。
example: The finance committee submits a quarterly financial report to the principal every three months.

def_zh: 初賽的；初步的；預備的
def_en: coming before a more important action or event, especially introducing or preparing for it
prep_trap: 比賽題必考詞（初賽 preliminary round vs 決賽 final round）：注意拼法為 pre-lim-i-nar-y。
example: The preliminary round of the singing contest will take place in the music room next Tuesday.

def_zh: 首屆的；創始的；就職的
def_en: an inaugural speech, meeting, or event is the first in a series of planned events
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -au-gu-（in-au-gu-ral）；指「第一屆舉辦的比賽或典禮」。
example: Our school is proud to host the inaugural inter-school robotics competition this coming Saturday.

def_zh: 紀念性的；作為紀念的
def_en: intended to help people remember and respect an important person or event in the past
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 mm，中間單寫 m（com-mem-o-ra-tive，與 memory 同源）；常用於修飾校慶紀念品。
example: Every graduate will receive a commemorative lapel badge engraved with the school motto.

def_zh: 預算；財政預算案；廉價的
def_en: a plan to show how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend
prep_trap: 注意中間有 d（budg-et）；在預算之內用 within budget，超出預算用 over budget，緊絀的預算用 on a tight budget。
example: We must choose a local campsite to ensure that our total expenditure remains within budget.

def_zh: 開支；支出總額；花費
def_en: the total amount of money that a government or person spends
prep_trap: Paper 3 財務報告高分詞（Income and Expenditure 收支表）：注意中間是 -pen-di-ture；在某方面的開支介詞用 expenditure on。
example: The treasurer prepared a detailed table showing the estimated income and expenditure for the carnival.

def_zh: （機構、活動或政府的）總收入；收益
def_en: the income that a government or company receives regularly
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，注意拼法為 rev-e-nue（中間是 e）；產生收入搭配動詞 generate revenue。
example: Selling handmade crafts at the fair helped our club generate extra revenue for future activities.

def_zh: （慈善活動或義賣的）全部收益；善款收入
def_en: the amount of money received from a particular event or activity or when something is sold
prep_trap: DSE 慈善信件必備神字！作名詞「收益」時重音在第一音節，且永遠以複數形式 proceeds 出現！來自某活動的收益介詞用 proceeds from。
example: All proceeds from the charity concert will go directly to the Elderly Care Foundation.

def_zh: 赤字；虧損；逆差
def_en: the total amount by which money spent is more than money received
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -fi-cit（c 發 /s/ 音）；出現赤字搭配動詞錄得 record / run a deficit。
example: The student union had to apply for a school subsidy to cover the small budget deficit.

def_zh: 盈餘；過剩；剩餘的
def_en: an amount that is more than is needed, or money left over after all costs have been paid
prep_trap: deficit 的反義詞：由 sur- + plus 構成；財政盈餘為 budget surplus。
example: Any financial surplus from the book sale will be saved for next year's reading programme.

def_zh: 報價單；估價；引語
def_en: a statement of how much a job, service, or product will cost, or words repeated from a book
prep_trap: Paper 3 採購比較題必考詞：注意由 quote 去 e 加 -ation 構成（quo-ta-tion）；向供應商索取報價用 obtain/request a quotation from。
example: We have obtained three price quotations from different catering companies for the graduation party.

def_zh: 發票；請款單
def_en: a list of things provided or work done together with their cost, for payment at a later time
prep_trap: 注意與 receipt（付款後的收據）的分別：invoice 是供應商要求買方付款的「發票/帳單」；清繳發票用 settle an invoice。
example: The coach company will issue an official invoice once we confirm the final number of passengers.

def_zh: （學生或長者）票價優惠；減價；讓步
def_en: a reduction in the usual price of something, especially for students, old people, or children
prep_trap: Paper 3 門票價格表常考詞（Concessionary rate / Student concessions）：注意前 c 後雙 ss（con-ces-sion）。
example: Full-time students and senior citizens can purchase concession tickets at half price at the entrance.

def_zh: 禮券；代金券；現金券
def_en: a piece of paper that can be used to pay for particular goods or services
prep_trap: Paper 3 獎品欄常考詞（Book voucher 書券 / Cash voucher 現金券）：注意拼法為 vouch-er。
example: The champion of the essay competition will be awarded a trophy and a five-hundred-dollar book voucher.

def_zh: 優惠券；折扣券；換領券
def_en: a piece of paper that can be used to get something without paying for it, or at a reduced price
prep_trap: 注意開頭是 cou-（讀 /kuː/），字尾是 -pon（cou-pon）；換領優惠券用 redeem a coupon。
example: Each helper will receive a free meal coupon that can be redeemed at the food stall.

def_zh: 誘因；獎勵；鼓勵措施
def_en: something that encourages a person to do something
prep_trap: 高分建議書詞彙：注意中間是 c（in-cen-tive）；提供誘因讓某人做某事用 provide an incentive for sb to do sth。
example: Offering house points as an extra incentive will definitely encourage more students to join the competition.

def_zh: 獎盃
def_en: a prize, such as a silver cup, that is given to the winner of a competition or race
prep_trap: 注意中間是 ph 發 /f/ 音（tro-phy）；複數需改 y 為 -ies（trophies）。
example: The winning debate team was awarded a silver trophy by the principal during morning assembly.

def_zh: 獎牌；勳章
def_en: a small flat piece of metal, often circular, given as a prize in a sporting event
prep_trap: 注意字尾是 -al（med-al），切勿與意為「金屬」的 metal 或「干預」的 meddle 混淆。
example: The top three runners in each race will receive a gold, silver, or bronze medal.

def_zh: 紀念牌匾；獎牌
def_en: a flat piece of metal, stone, wood, or plastic with writing on it that is attached to a wall or given as a prize
prep_trap: Paper 3 頒獎或開幕禮難字：注意字尾是 -que（讀 /k/ 音，plaque）。
example: The guest of honour unveiled a commemorative plaque at the entrance of the new library.

def_zh: 到會服務；餐飲供應
def_en: the activity of providing food and drink for a large number of people, for example at weddings and parties
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，Paper 3 派對及活動籌備必考（Catering service 到會服務）；動詞原形為 cater（cater for 照顧/迎合某人需要）。
example: We have hired a reliable local catering company to provide party snacks for the graduation dinner.

def_zh: 飲料；飲品（除水以外）
def_en: a drink of any type
prep_trap: 可數名詞（Food and beverages 餐飲）：注意前兩個元音都是 e（bev-er-age）。
example: Hot beverages and pastries will be available at the coffee corner during the registration period.

def_zh: （廚房或家庭）器皿；用具；餐具
def_en: a tool with a particular use, especially in a kitchen or house
prep_trap: 可數名詞，常作複數 utensils（Cooking utensils 煮食用具 / Eating utensils 餐具）；注意字尾是 -sil 而非 -sel。
example: Participants are encouraged to bring their own reusable eating utensils to reduce plastic waste at camp.

def_zh: 刀叉匙等餐具（統稱）
def_en: knives, forks, and spoons used for eating food
prep_trap: 絕對不可數集合名詞（不可加 -s 寫成 cutleries）！环保題常考 disposable plastic cutlery（即棄塑膠餐具）。
example: Starting from next month, the school tuck shop will no longer provide disposable plastic cutlery.

def_zh: 家用電器；器具
def_en: a device, machine, or piece of equipment, especially an electrical one that is used in the house
prep_trap: 可數名詞（與不可數的 equipment 不同，可加 -s 為 electrical appliances）！注意雙寫 pp，y 轉 i 加 -ance。
example: Please make sure all electrical appliances and lights are switched off before leaving the classroom.

def_zh: （科學實驗或體操的）儀器；器械；裝置
def_en: a set of equipment or tools or a machine that is used for a particular purpose, such as in a laboratory or gym
prep_trap: 常作不可數名詞（單複數同形）：注意雙寫 pp，後面兩個 a（ap-pa-ra-tus）。
example: Students must handle all glass laboratory apparatus with extreme care during the chemistry practical exam.

def_zh: 投影機；放映機
def_en: a device for showing films or images on a screen or other surface
prep_trap: Paper 3 借用場地器材表必考詞：注意字尾為 -tor 而非 -ter（pro-jec-tor）。
example: The IT prefects will help the guest speaker set up the digital projector and microphone.

def_zh: 麥克風；擴音器；咪高峰
def_en: a piece of equipment that you speak into to make your voice louder, or to record your voice
prep_trap: Paper 3 正式文書切勿寫口語簡稱 mic！必須拼寫全稱 mi-cro-phone。
example: We will need four wireless microphones and two speaker stands for the panel discussion tomorrow.

def_zh: 揚聲器；喇叭；廣播擴音器
def_en: a piece of equipment that changes electrical signals into sound, especially used in public places
prep_trap: 一字連寫（loud-speak-er）；透過廣播喇叭宣布用 announce over the loudspeaker。
example: Winning house results will be announced over the loudspeaker throughout the afternoon on Sports Day.

def_zh: 告示（板）；簡報；新聞快訊
def_en: a short news programme on television or radio, or an official notice/newsletter
prep_trap: Paper 3 校園宣傳必考（bulletin board 告示板）：注意雙寫 ll，中間是 e，字尾是 -tin（bul-le-tin）。
example: All promotional posters must be approved before being posted on the student union bulletin board.

def_zh: （學校或機構的）通告；傳閱文件；圓形的
def_en: a letter or notice that is sent to a large number of people at the same time
prep_trap: 香港學校極常用名詞（Parents' circular 家長通告）：注意字尾是 -lar（ar）而非 -ler（cir-cu-lar）。
example: A school circular regarding the winter uniform change was distributed to all students this morning.

def_zh: 會議議程；待議事項
def_en: a list of matters to be discussed at a meeting
prep_trap: Paper 3 會議紀錄（Minutes）必考詞：在議程上介詞必須用 on the agenda（而非 in）。
example: The first item on the agenda for today's meeting is the annual leadership camp budget.

def_zh: 會議紀錄
def_en: the written record of what was said and decided at a meeting
prep_trap: 指「會議紀錄」時永遠必須用複數形 minutes！擔任紀錄員寫會議紀錄搭配動詞 take the minutes。
example: As the secretary of the club, Tiffany is responsible for taking the minutes during meetings.

def_zh: 共識；一致意見
def_en: a generally accepted opinion or decision among a group of people
prep_trap: Paper 3 聽力討論題總結必備！注意全字有三個 s、一個 c（con-sen-sus），切勿拼成 concensus；達成共識用 reach a consensus on。
example: After a long discussion, the committee finally reached a consensus on the date of the carnival.

def_zh: 全體一致的；無異議的
def_en: if a group of people are unanimous, they all agree about one particular matter or vote the same way
prep_trap: 開頭雖是元音字母 u，但發半元音 /juː/，故前面冠詞必須用 a（a unanimous decision）而非 an！
example: The organizing committee made a unanimous decision to invite a local singer as our guest performer.

def_zh: 大多數；大比數
def_en: the larger number or part of something
prep_trap: Paper 3 數據報告必用（the vast majority of 絕大多數）：當 the majority of + 複數名詞作主語時，動詞須用複數！
example: According to the survey results, the vast majority of students prefer outdoor team-building activities.

def_zh: 少數；少數群體（如少數族裔）
def_en: any small group in society that is different from the rest, or a smaller number/part
prep_trap: 僅有少數人用 only a small minority of + 複數名詞；指少數族裔常用複數 ethnic minorities。
example: Only a small minority of respondents expressed dissatisfaction with the current library opening hours.

def_zh: 比例；部分；份額
def_en: the number or amount of a group or part of something when compared to the whole
prep_trap: 數據報告替換 percentage 的高分詞：形容比例高低必須用 large / high / small / low，切勿用 big 或 many！與某事物成正比用 in proportion to。
example: A significant proportion of the club's annual budget was spent on hiring professional sound equipment.

def_zh: 統計數據；統計數字；統計學
def_en: a collection of numerical facts or measurements, as about people, business conditions, or weather
prep_trap: 指「統計數據」時必須加 -s 且視為複數名詞，後接複數動詞（Statistics show that...，無需加 the）！
example: Recent official statistics show that over seventy percent of secondary students suffer from insufficient sleep.

def_zh: （問卷或調查的）受訪者；回答者
def_en: a person who answers a request for information, especially in a survey or questionnaire
prep_trap: Paper 3 調查報告必備神字！注意字尾是 -ent 而非 -ant（re-spond-ent），切勿把受訪者寫成 reporter 或 answerer！
example: Nearly eighty percent of the survey respondents agreed that the canteen should lower its prices.

def_zh: 受訪者；被面試者
def_en: the person who answers the questions during an interview
prep_trap: 注意字尾雙寫 ee（in-ter-view-ee）代表「被訪問/被面試的人」，而字尾 -er（interviewer）則是「考官/主持訪問的人」，切勿掉轉！
example: All interviewees are advised to dress formally and bring their academic portfolios to the interview.

def_zh: 可行性；切實可行程度
def_en: the possibility that can be made, done, or achieved, or is reasonable
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，計劃書高分詞（形容詞為 feasible）：評估某計劃的可行性用 assess the feasibility of the plan。
example: The principal asked the committee to study the financial feasibility of installing solar panels on campus.

def_zh: 可行的；行得通的；切實的
def_en: able to be made, done, or achieved
prep_trap: 注意開頭是 fea-，字尾是 -sible 而非 -sable（fea-si-ble）！替換 possible / can do 的最佳實戰詞。
example: Organizing a day camp at school is a much more feasible option given our limited budget.

def_zh: 切實可行的；能獨立維持的
def_en: able to work as intended or able to succeed
prep_trap: 注意拼法為 vi-a-ble（三音節）；常構成 viable alternative（可行的替代方案）。
example: Holding the bazaar in the covered playground is a viable alternative in case of heavy rain.

def_zh: 替代方案；另一選擇；可供替代的
def_en: something that is different from something else, especially from what is usual, and offering the possibility of choice
prep_trap: Paper 3 後備方案（Contingency plan）必考詞：注意中間是 -ter-na-；某事物的替代方案後面介詞必須用 to（an alternative to driving）！
example: The indoor gymnasium will serve as an alternative venue if the outdoor court is flooded.

def_zh: 應變（計劃）；突發事件；意外開支準備金
def_en: something that might possibly happen in the future, usually causing problems or making further arrangements necessary
prep_trap: Paper 3 戶外活動計劃書必考「應變計劃」（contingency plan）或「備用金」（contingency fund）：注意中間是 -tin-gen-cy。
example: We have prepared a detailed contingency plan in case a typhoon signal is hoisted tomorrow.

def_zh: 預防措施；安全防範
def_en: an action that is done to prevent something unpleasant or dangerous happening
prep_trap: 可數名詞，常作複數 safety precautions；採取預防措施固定搭配動詞 take precautions against。
example: Strict safety precautions must be taken when students are participating in water sports activities.

def_zh: 規章；規則；條例
def_en: an official rule or the act of controlling something
prep_trap: 常以複數形式 rules and regulations 出現；遵守規則搭配動詞 comply with / abide by the regulations。
example: All campers are required to strictly follow the campsite rules and fire safety regulations.

def_zh: 禁止；禁令
def_en: the act of officially not allowing something, or an order that does this
prep_trap: 注意中間有 h（pro-hi-bi-tion）；動詞 prohibit 用法為 prohibit sb from doing sth（介詞用 from）。
example: There is a strict prohibition on bringing outside food and drinks into the cinema auditorium.

def_zh: 限制；約束；限定條件
def_en: an official limit on something
prep_trap: 對某事物施加限制介詞必須用 on（impose restrictions on），切勿用 to！飲食限制為 dietary restrictions。
example: There is no age restriction for the family fun run, so young children are welcome.

def_zh: 監督；監管；指導
def_en: the act of watching a person or activity and making certain that everything is done correctly, safely, etc.
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，Paper 3 安全守則必考詞：在老師或成人的監督下，固定搭配介詞 under the supervision of a teacher。
example: Junior form students may only use the fitness room under the direct supervision of a teacher.

def_zh: 教練；導師；指導員
def_en: a person whose job is to teach people a practical skill, such as driving or a sport
prep_trap: 注意字尾是 -tor 而非 -ter（in-struc-tor）；專門指教授運動、急救、工藝或駕駛等實用技能的導師。
example: A qualified first-aid instructor will demonstrate how to treat minor burns and sprains properly.

def_zh: 示範；演示；展示
def_en: the act of showing someone how to do something, or how something works
prep_trap: Paper 3 切勿寫口語簡稱 demo！必須寫全稱 dem-on-stra-tion（注意中間是 o，與動詞 monster 無關）。
example: The guest chef will give a live cooking demonstration before students start making their own pastries.

def_zh: 工作坊；實踐研習班
def_en: a meeting of people to discuss and/or perform practical work in a subject or activity
prep_trap: 一字連寫，可數名詞；舉辦關於某主題的工作坊介詞用 hold/conduct a workshop on。
example: The Art Club will conduct a two-hour pottery workshop for beginners this Saturday afternoon.

def_zh: 小組導修課；補習班；教學指南
def_en: a period of study with a tutor involving one student or a small group
prep_trap: 注意由 tutor 加 -ial 構成（tu-to-ri-al）；指補習社為 tutorial centre。
example: Senior peer tutors will lead after-school remedial tutorials to help Secondary One students with mathematics.

def_zh: 師友計劃；導師指導制
def_en: the guidance provided by a mentor, especially an experienced person in a company or educational institution
prep_trap: 香港學校生涯規劃常考（Alumni Mentorship Programme 校友師友計劃）：注意 mentor 字尾是 -tor。
example: Through the alumni mentorship programme, senior students can gain valuable insights into various career paths.

def_zh: 實習職位；實習計劃
def_en: a period of time during which a student works for a company or organization in order to get experience
prep_trap: 注意中間有 r（in-tern-ship），實習生則是 intern；參加暑期實習用 do/complete a summer internship。
example: Completing a summer internship at a local newspaper helped Kelvin improve his journalistic writing skills.

def_zh: 獎學金
def_en: an amount of money given by a school, college, university, or other organization to pay for the studies of a person with great ability
prep_trap: 注意開頭是 schol-ar-（有 h，字根中間是 a 而非 o/e）；獲得獎學金用 be awarded a scholarship。
example: Outstanding students who excel in both academics and sports will be nominated for the scholarship.

def_zh: 招募；招聘；招收新成員
def_en: the process of finding people to work for a company or become a new member of an organization
prep_trap: 極高頻拼錯字！中間有不發音的 i（re-cruit-ment，如同 fruit 水果），切勿漏寫 i！
example: The Red Cross Youth Unit will set up a member recruitment booth in the covered playground.

def_zh: 職位空缺；空額；空房
def_en: a job or position that is available for someone to take, or a room in a hotel that is available
prep_trap: Paper 3 招聘信與報名表必考詞：注意中間是 -can-，複數需改 y 為 -ies（vacancies）；填補空缺用 fill a vacancy。
example: Since there are only twenty vacancies for the baking class, places will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.

def_zh: 名額；配額；限額
def_en: a fixed, limited amount or number that is officially allowed
prep_trap: 注意拼法為 quo-ta；當報名名額已滿時，常用 the quota is full / exceed the quota。
example: Each secondary school is given a maximum quota of five teams for the robotics competition.

def_zh: 優先權；優先考慮的事；當務之急
def_en: something that is very important and must be dealt with before other things
prep_trap: 注意由 prior 加 -ity 構成；給予某人優先權固定搭配為 give priority to sb（不可數用法）或 make sth a top priority。
example: Priority will be given to senior form students who are taking Visual Arts as an elective.

def_zh: 分配；撥出（資金、名額或時間）
def_en: to give something to someone as their share of a total amount, or to use in a particular way
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 ll（al-lo-cate）；把資源或名額分配給某人，介詞必須用 to（allocate funds/places to sb）。
collocations: allocated on a first-come, first-served basis
example: The school has allocated ten thousand dollars to the library for purchasing new English novels.

def_zh: 派發；分發；分配
def_en: to give something out to several people, or to spread or supply something
prep_trap: 替換 give out 的最佳正式動詞：把傳單或物資派發給某人，介詞用 to 或 among（distribute leaflets to passers-by）。
example: Student helpers will distribute programme booklets to guests at the entrance of the school hall.

def_zh: 傳閱；分發（文件）；流傳
def_en: to send something such as information, ideas, or documents from one person to another
prep_trap: 在委員會成員間傳閱文件用 circulate the agenda among members。
example: The secretary will circulate the meeting agenda via email to all committee members before Friday.

def_zh: 宣傳；推廣工作；公眾關注
def_en: the activity of making certain that someone or something attracts a lot of interest or attention from many people
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，Paper 3 計劃書小標題常客（Publicity and Promotion 宣傳與推廣）：注意中間是 c（pub-lic-i-ty）。
example: Our publicity team will design eye-catching posters and social media posts to promote the talent show.

def_zh: （用家或參加者的）推薦感言；見證語；證明書
def_en: a statement about the character or qualities of someone or something, often used in promotional materials
prep_trap: Paper 3 撰寫網頁或宣傳單張常考（Student testimonials 學生感言）：注意拼法為 tes-ti-mo-ni-al。
example: The promotional webpage includes positive testimonials from past participants who thoroughly enjoyed the exchange tour.

def_zh: 認可；背書；代言；支持
def_en: the act of saying that you approve of or support something or someone
prep_trap: 注意中間保留 e（en-dorse-ment）；獲得校方或名人的認可/支持用 gain the endorsement of。
example: The proposal must receive official endorsement from the Parent-Teacher Association before we can proceed.

def_zh: 合作；協作；聯辦
def_en: the situation of two or more people or organizations working together to create or achieve the same thing
prep_trap: Paper 3 跨學會或聯校活動必備高分詞！注意雙寫 ll（col-lab-o-ra-tion）；與某機構合辦固定搭配介詞短語 in collaboration with。
example: This leadership training camp is organized by the Student Union in collaboration with a local youth centre.

def_zh: 協調；統籌；配合
def_en: the act of making all the people involved in a plan or activity work together in an organized way
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，注意開頭雙 o（co-or-di-na-tion）；在幾個部門之間的協調介詞用 coordination between/among。
example: Successful execution of the annual carnival requires close coordination among all student union sub-committees.

def_zh: 好客；殷勤招待；款待
def_en: friendly and generous behaviour towards guests, or food and drink provided for guests at an event
prep_trap: 不可數名詞，Paper 3 感謝信必備高分詞！注意雖含 hospital 但與醫院無關；感謝某人的熱情款待用 thank sb for their warm hospitality。
example: We would like to thank our host families in New Zealand for their warm hospitality.

def_zh: 聲譽；名聲；口碑
def_en: the opinion that people in general have about someone or something, or how much respect or admiration someone receives
prep_trap: Paper 3 危機處理或投訴回應信必考（損害學校聲譽 damage the school's reputation）：以某事聞名介詞用 have a reputation for。
example: Organizing this inter-school debate tournament will certainly enhance our school's reputation in the district.

def_zh: 享負盛名的；有威望的；名牌的
def_en: very much respected and admired, usually because of being important or of high quality
prep_trap: 極高頻拼錯字！名詞是 prestige，變形容詞時去 e 加 -ious（pres-ti-gious，中間是 i 而非 e）！
example: Our school choir has been invited to perform at a prestigious international music festival.

def_zh: 信譽良好的；可靠的（公司或機構）
def_en: having a good reputation and able to be trusted
prep_trap: Paper 3 採購或挑選供應商必考詞（対応錄音中的 reliable / well-known company）：注意字尾為 -able（rep-u-ta-ble）。
example: We should order the camp T-shirts from a reputable local supplier to ensure good quality.

def_zh: 正宗的；道地的；真實可信的
def_en: if something is authentic, it is real, true, or what people say it is
prep_trap: 文化交流或美食節題常考（正宗美食 authentic cuisine）：注意開頭是 au-then-tic。
example: Visitors can taste authentic Thai street food prepared by professional chefs at the cultural fair.

def_zh: 全面的；綜合的；詳盡的
def_en: complete and including everything that is necessary
prep_trap: 極易與意為「易懂的」comprehensible（可理解的）混淆！comprehensive 指「涵蓋範圍全面的（如保險、訓練或報告）」。
example: All student volunteers will receive comprehensive training before the mentorship programme officially begins next month.

def_zh: 增長見聞的；資料豐富的；有教育意義的
def_en: providing a lot of useful information
prep_trap: 活動檢討或感謝信讚美講座必備詞：注意中間是 -for-ma-tive。
example: Students found the career talk highly informative and gained a clearer picture of university life.

def_zh: 互動的；雙向交流的
def_en: involving communication between people or reactions between things that work together
prep_trap: Paper 3 建議書改造沉悶活動必備詞（interactive games / workshops）：注意開頭是 in-ter-。
example: Adding interactive quiz games to the morning assembly will make the safety talk more engaging.

def_zh: 難忘的；值得紀念的
def_en: likely to be remembered or worth remembering
prep_trap: 演講稿及感謝信結尾高頻詞：注意由 memory 去 y 加 -able 構成（mem-o-ra-ble，中間無 i）。
example: Working together at the summer camp was a truly memorable experience for all Secondary Four students.

def_zh: 提倡；主張；擁護者
def_en: to publicly support or suggest an idea, development, or way of doing something
prep_trap: DSE 議論文首段必備高分動詞！作及物動詞時直接接名詞或 V-ing（advocate green living / advocate banning...），切勿接 to do！
example: Environmental groups strongly advocate imposing a heavier levy on disposable plastic shopping bags in Hong Kong.

def_zh: 實施；推行；落實（政策或措施）
def_en: to start using a plan or system
prep_trap: 替換 do / start a policy 的王牌動詞！及物動詞，直接接 policy / measure / scheme，後面絕不加介詞。
example: The government should implement stricter laws to penalize employers who exploit vulnerable foreign domestic helpers.

def_zh: 執法；強制執行（法律或規則）
def_en: to make people obey a law, or to make a particular situation happen or be accepted
prep_trap: 極易與 implement 混淆：implement 配 policy/plan（推行政策），而 enforce 專配 law/rule/ban（嚴格執法）！切勿寫成 enforce a person to do（那是 force）。
example: Unless the authorities strictly enforce the smoking ban, offenders will continue to ignore the regulations.

def_zh: 徵收（稅款或罰款）；強加；實行（限制）
def_en: to officially force a rule, tax, punishment, etc. to be obeyed or received
prep_trap: 必考介詞搭配：impose A on B（將罰款、稅項、禁令或壓力強加於某人/某事上），介詞必須用 on！
example: The government has decided to impose a heavy fine on drivers who park illegally.

def_zh: 紓緩；減輕（問題、壓力、貧困或痛楚）
def_en: to make something bad such as pain or problems less severe
prep_trap: 替換 solve / reduce 的保 4 神字（因社會問題往往只能「紓緩」而無法徹底根除）：注意雙寫 ll（al-le-vi-ate），直接接 problem / stress / burden。
example: Providing rental subsidies can temporarily alleviate the financial burden of grassroots families living in subdivided flats.

def_zh: 減緩；減輕（負面影響、風險或氣候變化）
def_en: to make something less harmful, unpleasant, or bad
prep_trap: 及物動詞，常與 negative impact / risk / climate change 搭配，直接接受詞，切勿加 against 或 on。
example: Planting more trees in urban areas helps mitigate the adverse effects of global warming.

def_zh: 使惡化；加劇（問題、矛盾或危機）
def_en: to make something that is already bad even worse
prep_trap: alleviate 的反義詞，替換 make...worse 的高分動詞：注意中間是 -ac-er-bate，直接接負面名詞（problem / crisis / gap）。
example: Rising housing prices have further exacerbated the wealth gap between the rich and the poor.

def_zh: 加重（病情、傷勢或問題）；使惡化
def_en: to make a bad situation or an illness worse
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 gg 及中間是 a（ag-gra-vate）；常指加重病情、傷勢或交通擠塞。
example: Staring at smartphone screens in the dark will severely aggravate eye strain and insomnia.

def_zh: 惡化；變壞；衰退
def_en: to become worse
prep_trap: 語法大伏！deteriorate 是不及物動詞（相對於及物的 worsen / exacerbate），後面絕對不可接賓語，亦不可用被動語態（不可寫 be deteriorated）！
example: Without regular physical exercise and a balanced diet, one's mental and physical health may deteriorate.

def_zh: 培養；陶冶（習慣、興趣、品格或價值觀）
def_en: to try to develop and improve something such as a skill, attitude, or relationship
prep_trap: 教育類作文萬用動詞（替換 develop a habit）：直接接 good habits / a reading habit / positive values。
example: Parents should read bedtime stories with young children to cultivate a lifelong reading habit.

def_zh: 促進；培育；培養（歸屬感、創意或關係）
def_en: to encourage the development or growth of ideas or feelings
prep_trap: 及物動詞，最常搭配抽象正向名詞，如 foster a sense of belonging（培養歸屬感）或 foster mutual understanding（促進互相理解）。
example: Organizing inter-house competitions can foster a strong sense of belonging and team spirit among students.

def_zh: 培育；養育；扶持（人才或潛能）
def_en: to take care of, feed, and protect someone or something, especially young children, or to help talent develop
prep_trap: 注意拼法為 nur-ture（切勿與 nature 自然混淆）；常用於培育青年人才（nurture young talent）。
example: Schools should provide diverse extracurricular activities to nurture students' artistic and athletic talents.

def_zh: 灌輸；逐漸培養（道德觀念、紀律或責任感）
def_en: to put a feeling, idea, or principle gradually into someone's mind, so that it has a strong influence on the way they think or behave
prep_trap: 英式單 l（美式亦作 instill），過去式須雙寫 ll（instilled）；必考介詞搭配：instil A in/into B（將正確價值觀灌輸給學生）。
example: Community service programmes help instil a strong sense of social responsibility in young people.

def_zh: 提升；提高；增強（效率、能力、意識或質素）
def_en: to improve the quality, amount, or strength of something
prep_trap: 替換 improve 的第一高頻詞！注意受詞必須是「正面事物」（enhance efficiency / competitiveness / awareness），切勿用來接 problem（問題是 alleviate 而非 enhance）！
example: Joining overseas exchange tours can broaden students' horizons and enhance their language proficiency.

def_zh: 促進；增強（信心、士氣、免疫力或經濟）
def_en: to improve or increase something
prep_trap: 及物動詞，直接接 self-esteem / morale / immunity / tourism，語氣充滿活力與正面推動力。
example: Regular aerobic exercise not only boosts our immune system but also relieves daily mental stress.

def_zh: 加強；鞏固；強化（關係、監管或聯繫）
def_en: to make something stronger or more effective, or to become stronger
prep_trap: 極易拼錯！由名詞 strength（g 在 th 前）加動詞後綴 -en 構成（strength-en），切勿漏寫 g 或 h！
example: Having dinner together every evening is a simple way to strengthen family bonds and communication.

def_zh: 強化；加深（記憶、知識、觀念或刻板印象）
def_en: to make an idea, belief, or feeling stronger
prep_trap: 注意拼法為 re-in-force；常用於課後溫習鞏固知識（reinforce classroom learning）或強化正面行為。
example: Doing interactive online quizzes after class helps students reinforce the knowledge acquired in lectures.

def_zh: 鞏固；加強（基礎、知識或地位）
def_en: to become, or cause something to become, stronger, and more certain
prep_trap: 中間包含 solid（穩固的）：con-sol-i-date；教育題常寫 consolidate students' foundation（鞏固學生的根基）。
example: Assigned homework should aim to consolidate students' understanding rather than merely keeping them busy.

def_zh: 擴闊；開拓（視野、眼界或知識面）
def_en: to become wider, or to cause something to become wider, especially knowledge or experience
prep_trap: DSE 作文必背詞組 broaden one's horizons（擴闊視野）：注意由形容詞 broad 加 -en 構成，horizons 必須加 -s（複數）！
example: Reading biographies of great leaders can broaden students' horizons and inspire them to pursue excellence.

def_zh: 充實；豐富（校園生活、經驗或知識）
def_en: to improve the quality of something by adding something else
prep_trap: 由前缀 en- + rich 構成；專門搭配 life / learning experience / school life（切勿用執意金錢的發達，那叫 get rich）。
example: Joining different clubs and societies can greatly enrich students' campus life and social circle.

def_zh: 使具備（技能或知識）；裝備
def_en: to provide a person or a place with objects or skills that are necessary for a particular purpose
prep_trap: 過去式及分詞必須雙寫 pp（equipped）！必背黃金句型：equip students with practical skills（介詞必須用 with）。
example: Vocational training courses equip young graduates with practical workplace skills for their future careers.

def_zh: 促進；使便利；有助於（溝通、學習或過程）
def_en: to make something possible or easier
prep_trap: 語法大伏！facilitate 的受詞必須是「過程/行動/事情」（facilitate communication / learning），絕對不可接「人」（不可寫 facilitate students to learn）！
example: Instant messaging applications greatly facilitate real-time communication among students working on group projects.

def_zh: 激發；刺激（興趣、思考、創意或經濟）
def_en: to encourage something to grow, develop, or become active
prep_trap: 及物動詞，常搭配 interest / critical thinking / economic growth。
example: Using multimedia videos in history lessons can effectively stimulate students' interest in the subject.

def_zh: 激勵；推動；使有動力
def_en: to make someone eager to do something
prep_trap: 句型為 motivate sb to do sth；被動語態 be motivated to do sth（有動力做某事）。
example: Setting clear and achievable short-term goals can motivate students to study harder for exams.

def_zh: 啟發；鼓舞；激勵
def_en: to make someone feel that they want to do something and can do it
prep_trap: 句型為 inspire sb to do sth（鼓舞某人做某事）或 inspire confidence in sb。
