example: The Paralympic athlete's speech inspired many students to overcome adversity with perseverance and courage.

def_zh: 鼓勵；促進；支持
def_en: to make someone more likely to do something, or to make something more likely to happen
prep_trap: 注意中間是 courage（勇氣）：接人時用 encourage sb to do sth；若直接接動作，則必須用動名詞 V-ing（encourage recycling）。
example: Schools should encourage students to participate in volunteer work during their summer holidays.

def_zh: 勸阻；打消…的念頭；使氣餒
def_en: to make someone feel less confident, enthusiastic, and positive about something, or less willing to do it
prep_trap: 必考介詞陷阱！encourage 用 to do，但相反詞 discourage 卻必須配 from V-ing（discourage sb from smoking）！
example: Increasing tobacco tax is an effective way to discourage teenagers from picking up smoking.

def_zh: 阻嚇；威懾；制止（罪案或違規行為）
def_en: to prevent someone from doing something or to make someone less enthusiastic about doing something by making it difficult for them or by threatening bad results
prep_trap: 過去式及現在分詞必須雙寫 rr（deterred / deterring）！結構與 discourage 完全相同：deter offenders from committing crimes（介詞必用 from）。
example: Installing closed-circuit television cameras in dark alleys can effectively deter potential criminals from committing offences.

def_zh: 預防；防止；阻止
def_en: to stop something from happening or someone from doing something
prep_trap: 核心句型：prevent sb/sth (from) V-ing（介詞用 from，絕對不可接 to do！）。
example: Getting vaccinated before winter is the most reliable way to prevent severe seasonal influenza.

def_zh: （以法律或校規）明令禁止；不准
def_en: to officially refuse to allow something
prep_trap: 替換 ban 的高分正式動詞：結構為 prohibit sb from V-ing（介詞必須用 from，與 forbid sb to do 不同！）。
example: New legislation should be introduced to strictly prohibit the sale of energy drinks to children.

def_zh: 禁止；不許
def_en: to refuse to allow something, especially officially, or to prevent a particular plan of action
prep_trap: 過去式為 forbade，過去分詞為 forbidden（雙寫 dd）；句型為 forbid sb to do sth（與 prohibit sb from doing 不同！）。
example: School rules strictly forbid students to bring mobile phones into the examination hall.

def_zh: 明令禁止；取締；禁令
def_en: to forbid something, especially officially
prep_trap: 作名詞時，對某事的禁令介詞必須用 on（impose a ban on plastic straws）；作動詞時過去式須雙寫 nn（banned），句型為 ban sb from doing sth。
example: Many citizens support the government's decision to impose a total ban on e-cigarettes.

def_zh: 限制；控制；約束
def_en: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something and reduce its size or prevent it from increasing
prep_trap: 將某事物的數量或時間限制在某範圍內，介詞必須用 to（restrict screen time to two hours）。
example: Parents should restrict children's daily screen time to two hours to protect their eyesight.

def_zh: 遏制；抑制；控制（通脹、罪案或壞習慣）
def_en: to control or limit something that is not wanted
prep_trap: DSE 議論文高分單音節動詞：及物動詞，直接接負面趨勢（curb carbon emissions / curb youth crime）。
example: The government must introduce decisive measures to curb the rapid rise in housing prices.

def_zh: 打擊；對抗；防止（罪案、氣候變化或疾病）
def_en: to try to stop something unpleasant or harmful from happening or increasing
prep_trap: 替換 fight against 的高分及物動詞：直接接負面名詞（combat climate change / combat crime），後面不需加 against 或 with！
example: International cooperation is urgently needed to combat global warming and extreme weather events.

def_zh: 處理；解決；應對（難題或危機）
def_en: to try to deal with something or someone
prep_trap: 替換 deal with 的王牌及物動詞！直接接 the problem / the issue，千萬不可受 deal with 影響而寫成 tackle with！
example: To tackle the ageing population problem, the government should allocate more resources to healthcare.

def_zh: 正視；處理；設法解決（問題或訴求）
def_en: to give attention to or deal with a matter or problem
prep_trap: 除了作名詞「地址」，DSE 寫作中極常作及物動詞「處理/正視」（address the issue / address students' needs），直接接賓語，不加 to 或 with！
example: Schools must hire more social workers to address the emotional needs of stressed students.

def_zh: 解決；化解（衝突、分歧或糾紛）
def_en: to solve or end a problem or difficulty
prep_trap: 比 solve 更正式，特別適合搭配人際衝突、糾紛或矛盾（resolve conflicts / disputes / differences）。
example: Open and honest communication is the best way to resolve conflicts between parents and teenagers.

def_zh: 根除；撲滅；徹底消滅（貧窮、疾病或惡習）
def_en: to get rid of something completely or destroy something bad
prep_trap: 語氣極強（指 100% 徹底根除），適合搭配 poverty / infectious diseases / discrimination，直接接賓語。
example: Education is the most powerful weapon to eradicate intergenerational poverty in developing countries.

def_zh: 消除；排除；淘汰
def_en: to remove or take away someone or something
prep_trap: 注意拼法為 e-lim-i-nate（中間兩個 i）；從某處消除某物介詞用 eliminate A from B。
example: Adopting electronic textbooks can eliminate the need for students to carry heavy schoolbags daily.

def_zh: 危及；損害；使陷於險境
def_en: to put something such as a plan or system in danger of being harmed or damaged
prep_trap: 注意開頭是 jeop-（發 /dʒep/ 音，o 不發音）；替換 harm / damage 的高分及物動詞（jeopardize one's health / future）。
example: Taking unproven slimming pills bought online can seriously jeopardize young people's physical health.

def_zh: 削弱；暗中損害（自信、健康、關係或權威）
def_en: to make someone less confident, less powerful, or less likely to succeed, or to make something weaker, often gradually
prep_trap: DSE 閱卷員極愛的論證動詞！專門用來指「漸漸削弱抽象正面事物」（如 undermine self-esteem / family harmony / competitiveness）。
example: Constant comparison with peers on social media can severely undermine teenagers' self-esteem.

def_zh: 損害；削弱（視力、記憶力、判斷力或身體機能）
def_en: to spoil something or make it weaker so that it is less effective
prep_trap: 由 im- + pair 構成；在健康與科技題中專門搭配生理或認知能力（impair eyesight / memory / judgment / concentration）。
example: Chronic sleep deprivation will inevitably impair students' memory, concentration, and academic performance.

def_zh: 阻礙；妨礙（發展、進步或學習）
def_en: to limit the ability of someone to do something, or to limit the development of something
prep_trap: 及物動詞，常搭配 personal growth / all-round development / economic progress，或用 hinder sb from doing sth。
example: Overprotective parenting may hinder children from developing independence and problem-solving skills.

def_zh: 妨礙；束縛；阻撓（救援、經濟或效率）
def_en: to prevent someone doing something easily
prep_trap: 及物動詞，與 hinder 同義，可直接接 development / recovery / efficiency。
example: A lack of affordable childcare services often hampers women from rejoining the workforce.

def_zh: 阻礙；阻止；減緩（進度或學習）
def_en: to make it more difficult for something to happen or more difficult for someone to do something
prep_trap: 及物動詞，直接接名詞（impede learning / impede progress），切勿加 to。
example: Excessive noise from nearby construction sites can seriously impede students' classroom learning.

def_zh: 剝奪；使喪失（機會、睡眠或權利）
def_en: to take something, especially something necessary or pleasant, away from someone
prep_trap: DSE 必考介詞固定搭配：deprive sb of sth（剝奪某人的某事物），被動語態為 be deprived of（介詞必須用 of，切勿漏寫！）。
example: Heavy workloads and endless tutorial classes often deprive Hong Kong students of sufficient rest.

def_zh: 忽略；疏忽照顧；忽視
def_en: to not give enough care or attention to people or things that are your responsibility
prep_trap: 無論作動詞或名詞皆直接接被忽略的事物，切勿與介詞 to 連用（但作名詞時可用 neglect of duty）。
example: Busy working parents should not neglect the emotional needs of their growing children.

def_zh: 忽略；未注意到；忽視（重要性或問題）
def_en: to fail to notice or consider something or someone
prep_trap: 及物動詞，常在讓步段或轉折段使用被動語態：The importance of X should not be overlooked（…的重要性不容忽視）。
example: While pursuing academic excellence, schools must not overlook the importance of moral education.

def_zh: 低估；輕視（風險、壓力或影響）
def_en: to fail to guess or understand the real cost, size, difficulty, etc. of something
prep_trap: 由 under + estimate 構成；常搭配 negative impact / severity / difficulty。
example: Teenagers often underestimate the long-term health risks associated with vaping and smoking.

def_zh: 誇大；言過其實
def_en: to make something seem larger, more important, better, or worse than it really is
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 gg（ex-ag-ger-ate）；社交媒體題常用以指網民或廣告誇大真相。
example: Social media influencers often exaggerate the effectiveness of beauty products to attract young buyers.

def_zh: 扭曲；歪曲（價值觀、事實或真相）
def_en: to change the shape or sound of something so that it seems strange, or to report facts in an untrue way
prep_trap: 及物動詞，青少年與傳媒題必備：distort teenagers' values（扭曲青少年價值觀）或 distort the truth。
example: Violent online games and materialistic advertisements may distort young people's moral values.

def_zh: 誤導；使誤信
def_en: to cause someone to believe something that is not true
prep_trap: 過去式及過去分詞為 misled（單 e，切勿拼成 mislead 或 misleaded！）；誤導某人做某事用 mislead consumers into buying。
example: Fake news circulating on social media can easily mislead the public and cause panic.

def_zh: 沉迷於；縱情於；溺愛
def_en: to allow yourself or another person to have something enjoyable, especially more than is good for you
prep_trap: 必考介詞搭配：表示「沉迷於電子遊戲/享樂」時，必須加介詞 in（indulge in online gaming）；若直接接人（indulge children）則解作「溺愛孩子」。
example: Students who lack self-discipline may easily indulge in online games and neglect their studies.

def_zh: 使沉浸於；使完全投入（語言環境或虛擬世界）
def_en: to become completely involved in something
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 mm（im-merse）；必須搭配反身代名詞或被動語態 + 介詞 in：immerse oneself in / be immersed in an English-speaking environment。
example: Studying abroad allows students to immerse themselves in an authentic English-speaking environment.

def_zh: 使接觸到；使暴露於（文化、風險或不良資訊）
def_en: to give someone experience of something, or to put someone in a situation where they are not protected from something harmful
prep_trap: DSE 萬用正反兩面神字！結構永遠是 expose sb to sth / be exposed to sth（這裏的 to 是介詞，若接動詞必須用 V-ing！）。
example: Without parental guidance, young children may be exposed to inappropriate violent content on the Internet.

def_zh: 使遭受；使承受（壓力或批評）；易受…影響的
def_en: to cause someone or something to experience something unpleasant
prep_trap: 作動詞或形容詞時，必須搭配介詞 to（be subjected to immense pressure 承受巨大壓力 / be subject to change 可予更改）。
example: Victims of cyberbullying are often subjected to relentless online harassment and malicious rumours.

def_zh: 屈服於；抵受不住（朋輩壓力、誘惑或壓力）
def_en: to lose the determination to oppose something; to accept defeat
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 cc 且字尾 b 不發音（suc-cumb）；不及物動詞，必須搭配介詞 to（succumb to peer pressure / temptation）。
example: Teenagers with low self-esteem are more likely to succumb to negative peer pressure.

def_zh: 產生（成果或效益）；屈服於
def_en: to supply or produce something positive such as a profit, an amount of food, or information, or to give up control
prep_trap: 注意 i 在 e 前（yield）；作及物動詞解「產生（良好結果）」：yield positive results；作不及物動詞加 to 解「屈服於」：yield to temptation。
example: Investing more resources in early childhood education will yield significant long-term social benefits.

def_zh: 抵制；抗拒；忍住（誘惑或壓力）
def_en: to fight against something or someone that is attacking you, or to stop yourself from doing something that you want to do
prep_trap: 及物動詞，直接接 temptation / peer pressure；若後接動詞，必須用動名詞 V-ing（resist buying unnecessary items），絕對不可接 to do！
example: Moral education helps young people build the willpower needed to resist unhealthy temptations.

def_zh: 承受；頂住；經受得住（壓力、逆境或考驗）
def_en: to be strong enough, or not be changed by something, or to oppose a person or thing successfully
prep_trap: 過去式及過去分詞為 withstood；及物動詞，直接接 pressure / adversity / extreme weather，不需加 against。
example: Participating in outbound training camps teaches students how to withstand stress and overcome setbacks.

def_zh: 面對；正視（困難、挑戰或恐懼）
def_en: to face, meet, or deal with a difficult situation or person
prep_trap: 主動語態直接接困難（confront challenges）；被動語態則配 with（be confronted with difficulties 面臨困難）。
example: When confronted with academic failure, students should seek help rather than giving up easily.

def_zh: 遇到；遭遇（困難、挫折或問題）
def_en: to experience something, especially something unpleasant, or to meet someone unexpectedly
prep_trap: 替換 meet difficulties 的最佳及物動詞！直接接 difficulties / obstacles / problems，千萬不可加 with（不可寫 encounter with problems）！
example: Freshmen often encounter various difficulties when adapting to a new university learning environment.

def_zh: 克服；戰勝（困難、障礙或恐懼）
def_en: to defeat or succeed in controlling or dealing with something
prep_trap: 過去式為 overcame，過去分詞為 overcome（與原形同形！）；直接接 obstacles / adversity / stage fright。
example: With the encouragement of his teachers, Jason finally overcame his fear of public speaking.

def_zh: 克服；跨越（重重困難或難關）
def_en: to deal successfully with a difficulty or problem
prep_trap: overcome 的進階同義詞（中間含 mount 山，喻意翻越高山般的難關）：直接接 hurdles / difficulties。
example: Perseverance and a positive mindset enable young athletes to surmount seemingly impossible hurdles.

def_zh: 堅持不懈；鍥而不捨
def_en: to try to do or continue doing something in a determined way, despite having problems
prep_trap: 注意拼法為 per-se-vere（名詞為 perseverance）；不及物動詞，堅持做某事介詞用 persevere in V-ing 或 persevere with sth。
example: Those who persevere in the face of adversity will eventually achieve their personal goals.

def_zh: 努力爭取；力求；奮鬥
def_en: to try very hard to do something or to make something happen, especially for a long time
prep_trap: DSE 結論段呼籲必用動詞！接名詞時用 strive for（strive for excellence 力臻完善），接動詞時用 strive to do sth。
example: Students should strive for a healthy balance between academic studies and leisure activities.

def_zh: 竭力；盡力嘗試；努力
def_en: to try to do something, or an effort or attempt to do something
prep_trap: 英式拼法保留 u（en-deav-our）；作動詞時後接不定詞（endeavour to do sth，替換 try hard to do）。
example: Our school will endeavour to provide more career guidance for senior form students.

def_zh: 立志；渴望成為；追求
def_en: to have a strong want or hope to do or have something
prep_trap: 生涯規劃題高分詞（名詞為 aspiration 抱負）：立志做某事用 aspire to do sth / aspire to a career in。
example: Many young graduates aspire to build a rewarding career in the financial technology sector.

def_zh: 追求（夢想、學位或事業）；從事
def_en: to try to do or achieve something over a period of time
prep_trap: 極高頻拼錯字！首音節是 pur- 而非 per-（pur-sue，切勿與 persuade 混淆）！直接接 dreams / further studies / a career。
example: More secondary school graduates are choosing to pursue further studies at overseas universities.

def_zh: 達到；獲得（目標、成就或水平）
def_en: to reach or succeed in getting something
prep_trap: 替換 get / reach 的正式及物動詞：注意雙寫 tt（at-tain），直接接目標或水平（attain a high standard / attain one's goal）。
example: Through years of rigorous training, the young pianist finally attained an international professional standard.

def_zh: 習得；獲得（知識、技能或經驗）
def_en: to get or obtain something, especially knowledge, a skill, or a habit
prep_trap: DSE 寫作替換 learn / get knowledge 的首選動詞！注意開頭是 ac-（ac-quire），切勿與意為「要求」的 require 混淆。
example: Participating in summer internships enables university students to acquire hands-on experience in the workplace.

def_zh: 取得；獲得（許可、資訊、學位或簽證）
def_en: to get something, especially by asking for it, buying it, working for it, or producing it from something else
prep_trap: 替換 get 的正式動詞，最常搭配具體文件、數據或許可（obtain permission / obtain a degree / obtain information from）。
example: Researchers conducted street interviews to obtain first-hand data on citizens' recycling habits.

def_zh: 保留；留住（人才、記憶或傳統文化）
def_en: to keep or continue to have something
prep_trap: 替換 keep 的高分及物動詞：社會議題常寫 retain local talent（留住本地人才）或 retain traditional buildings（保留傳統建築）。
example: The government must improve living conditions to attract and retain top international talent.

def_zh: 維持；支撐（生命、長期發展或興趣）；遭受（傷亡）
def_en: to cause or allow something to continue for a period of time, or to suffer damage/injury
prep_trap: 形容詞 sustainable（可持續的）之動詞原形：除了解「維持（sustain economic growth）」，在新聞或報告中亦常解作「遭受傷勢（sustain minor injuries）」。
example: Relying solely on tourism is not enough to sustain long-term economic growth in the city.

def_zh: 保育；保存；保護（歷史古蹟、傳統文化或自然生態）
def_en: to keep something as it is, especially in order to prevent it from decaying or being damaged or destroyed
prep_trap: 注意與 conserve 的分別：preserve 強調「原封不動地保存免受破壞」（如 preserve historical monuments / cultural heritage）。
example: Preserving historical buildings helps younger generations understand the unique history and roots of Hong Kong.

def_zh: 節約；保育（水電、能源或自然資源）
def_en: to keep and protect something from damage, change, or waste
prep_trap: 環保題必考：conserve 強調「明智地使用、不浪費有限資源」（conserve energy / water / natural resources）。
example: Every citizen has a responsibility to conserve water and electricity in their daily lives.

def_zh: 保障；捍衛；保護（公眾健康、權益或安全）
def_en: to protect something from harm
prep_trap: 替換 protect 的高分及物動詞！一字連寫（safe-guard），常搭配 rights / public health / interests。
example: Stricter food safety laws are essential to safeguard public health and consumer rights.

def_zh: 維護；秉持；支持（核心價值、公義、校規或標準）
def_en: to defend or keep a principle or law, or to say that a decision that has already been made, especially a legal one, is correct
prep_trap: 過去式及過去分詞為 upheld；專門搭配崇高抽象的原則或價值（uphold justice / academic integrity / core values）。
example: Universities must penalize plagiarism strictly in order to uphold academic integrity and fairness.

def_zh: 妥協；折衷；損害（健康、安全或質素）
def_en: to accept that you will reduce your demands or change your opinion in order to reach an agreement, or to risk having a harmful effect on something
prep_trap: 一詞兩用：作不及物動詞或名詞解「達成妥協」（reach a compromise）；作及物動詞則解「因遷就而損害（健康/安全）」（compromise one's health / safety）。
example: Employees should never compromise their physical and mental health for the sake of overtime pay.

def_zh: 犧牲；捨棄（休息、家庭時間或長遠利益）
def_en: to give up something that is valuable to you in order to help another person or achieve something else
prep_trap: 注意拼法為 sac-ri-fice（c 而非 s）；為了 B 而犧牲 A 的句型為 sacrifice A for B。
example: Many senior students sacrifice their sleeping time for extra revision before the public examinations.

def_zh: 把…列為優先；優先處理
def_en: to decide which of a group of things are the most important so that you can deal with them first
prep_trap: 英式亦作 prioritise；將 A 置於 B 之前優先考慮，介詞搭配為 prioritize A over B。
example: Effective time management requires students to prioritize urgent assignments over leisure activities.

def_zh: 強調；重視；著重
def_en: to show that something is very important or worth giving attention to
prep_trap: DSE 萬年高頻介詞陷阱！動詞 emphasize 是及物動詞，後面絕對不可加 on（必須寫 emphasize the importance of）！只有轉用名詞短語 put emphasis on 才可加 on！
example: Health experts repeatedly emphasize the importance of eating five servings of fruit and vegetables daily.

def_zh: 突顯；強調；最精彩的部分
def_en: to attract attention to or emphasize something important, or the best/most exciting part of an event
prep_trap: 作動詞時直接接賓語（highlight the urgent need for...）；作名詞時可指活動的重頭戲（the highlight of the camp）。
example: The recent tragic accident has highlighted the urgent need for stricter industrial safety regulations.

def_zh: 突顯；強調（嚴重性或重要性）
def_en: to emphasize the importance something has
prep_trap: highlight / emphasize 的高階替換詞：一字連寫，直接接 the importance / severity of。
example: The survey findings underscore the importance of providing career counselling to junior secondary students.

def_zh: 說明；闡明；舉例印證
def_en: to show the meaning or truth of something more clearly, especially by giving examples
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 ll（il-lus-trate）；在議論文舉例後總結時，可用 This example clearly illustrates that...（替換 shows that）。
example: This real-life case clearly illustrates how cyberbullying can destroy a teenager's mental health.

def_zh: 證明；展現（能力或質素）；示範
def_en: to show or make something clear, or to show that you have a particular ability or quality
prep_trap: 替換 show / prove 的高分學術動詞：常寫 Studies have demonstrated that... 或 demonstrate leadership skills。
example: Numerous scientific studies have demonstrated that regular exercise significantly reduces the risk of depression.

def_zh: 作為…的典範；例證；體現
def_en: to be or give a typical example of something
prep_trap: 注意開頭是 ex-em-（有 e，與 example 的 a 不同！）；常用於讚揚某人或某事體現了優良品質。
example: The selfless dedication of medical workers during the pandemic exemplified true professionalism and courage.

def_zh: 意味著；標誌著；表示
def_en: to be a sign of something; to mean
prep_trap: 由 sign 加 -ify 構成；及物動詞，替換 mean 的高分詞（signify a major milestone 標誌著重要里程碑）。
example: The opening of the new railway line signifies a major step forward in regional integration.

def_zh: 顯示；指出；表明
def_en: to show, point, or make clear in another way
prep_trap: Paper 3 數據報告及 Paper 2 引用數據必用：The survey results indicate that...（替換 show that）。
example: Recent survey figures indicate that over sixty percent of teenagers prefer shopping online.

def_zh: 揭示；反映；揭露（真相或隱藏問題）
def_en: to make known or show something that is surprising or that was previously secret
prep_trap: 及物動詞，常搭配 statistics / findings / reports 作主語（The report reveals that...）。
example: Official statistics reveal a worrying upward trend in youth crime related to online scams.

def_zh: 反映（現象）；深刻反思（加 on）
def_en: to show, express, or be a sign of something, or to think carefully, especially about possibilities and opinions
prep_trap: 一詞兩用：作及物動詞直接接賓語解「反映情況」（reflect the reality）；作不及物動詞加介詞 on/upon 解「反思自己的行為」（reflect on one's mistakes）。
example: Writing a personal journal allows students to reflect on their daily experiences and emotions.

def_zh: 把…歸因於；認為…是由…造成；特質（名詞）
def_en: to say or think that something is the result of a particular thing
prep_trap: DSE 分析原因必背高分句型：attribute A（結果）to B（原因），被動語態為 A can be attributed to B（A 可歸因於 B，介詞必須用 to）！
example: The rapid rise in childhood obesity can be largely attributed to unhealthy dietary habits.

def_zh: 源於；由…引起；起因於
def_en: to start or develop as the result of something
prep_trap: 過去式須雙寫 mm（stemmed）；必考介詞搭配：A（結果）stems from B（原因），絕對不可用被動語態（不可寫 is stemmed from）！
example: Many family conflicts stem from a lack of mutual understanding between parents and teenagers.

def_zh: 發源於；起源於
def_en: to come from a particular place, time, situation, etc.
prep_trap: 不及物動詞（無被動語態），後接地點用 in，接原因或人用 from（originate from/in）。
example: This traditional festival originated in ancient China over two thousand years ago.

def_zh: （問題、困難或衝突）出現；產生；由…引起
def_en: to happen or start to exist, especially a problem or difficulty
prep_trap: 過去式 arose，過去分詞 arisen；不及物動詞（不可用被動語態），常以 problems / conflicts / misunderstandings 作主語，後接介詞 from（arise from 由…引起）。
example: Serious misunderstandings often arise from poor communication between employers and foreign domestic helpers.

def_zh: 引起；喚起；激發（公眾關注、興趣或同情）
def_en: to cause someone to have a particular feeling or interest
prep_trap: 極易與不及物的 arise 混淆！arouse 是及物動詞，後面必須接抽象情緒或關注（arouse public awareness / arouse students' interest in）！
example: The documentary successfully aroused public concern over the plight of endangered marine animals.

def_zh: 提高（意識或標準）；籌集（資金）；撫養
def_en: to lift something to a higher position, or to increase the amount or level of something
prep_trap: DSE 必分清 raise（及物動詞，過去式 raised，後必接賓語如 raise awareness / raise funds）與 rise（不及物動詞，過去式 rose，後不接賓語如 prices rose）！
example: The charity concert aims to raise funds for underprivileged children and raise awareness of poverty.

def_zh: 引發；觸發（疾病、焦慮、危機或強烈反應）
def_en: to cause something to start, especially something bad or violent
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 gg（trig-ger）；替換 cause 的高分及物動詞，特別適合搭配突發的負面後果（trigger anxiety / asthma attacks / heated debate）。
example: Excessive academic pressure can easily trigger severe anxiety and depression among secondary school students.

def_zh: 引發（激烈討論或爭議）；激發（興趣或創意）
def_en: to cause the start of something, especially an argument or fighting, or to inspire interest
prep_trap: DSE 議論文首段背景引入神字：The recent proposal has sparked a heated debate over whether...（引發了關於…的激烈討論）。
example: The proposed waste charging scheme has sparked a heated debate across society in recent months.

def_zh: 激起（憤怒或反對）；引發（深思）
def_en: to cause a reaction, especially a negative one, or to make people think deeply
prep_trap: 及物動詞，除解作激起憤怒（provoke public outcry），亦構成高分複合形容詞 thought-provoking（發人深省的）。
example: The thought-provoking film encourages audiences to reflect on the true meaning of family happiness.

def_zh: 誘發；引起（睡眠、壓力或購買行為）
def_en: to persuade someone to do something, or to cause a physical or mental condition
prep_trap: 健康與生活題高分詞：常構成複合形容詞 stress-induced（由壓力引發的，如 stress-induced insomnia）。
example: Listening to soft classical music before bedtime can help relax the mind and induce sleep.

def_zh: 牽涉；需要；必然伴隨（成本、努力或風險）
def_en: to make something necessary, or to involve it
prep_trap: 替換 need / involve 的高階及物動詞：若後接動作，必須用動名詞 V-ing（entail spending huge sums of money），不可接 to do。
example: Building an artificial island will inevitably entail massive construction costs and potential ecological damage.

def_zh: 包含；涉及；使參與（加 in）
def_en: if an activity or situation involves something, that thing is a part of it, or to include someone in an activity
prep_trap: 後接動作時必須用動名詞 V-ing（The job involves working on weekends）；表「參與某活動」用 be involved in（介詞必用 in）。
example: Students who are actively involved in community service tend to have greater empathy for others.

def_zh: 參加；參與（活動或比賽）
def_en: to take part in or become involved in an activity
prep_trap: 不及物動詞，後面必須加介詞 in 才可接活動（participate in extracurricular activities），切勿像 join 一樣直接接活動！
example: All Secondary Four students are encouraged to participate in the upcoming leadership training camp.

def_zh: 參與；從事（加 in）；吸引…的注意力
def_en: to become involved in an activity, or to interest someone in something and keep them thinking about it
prep_trap: DSE 寫作超高頻詞组：engage in（參與/從事某活動，後接名詞或 V-ing），比 join / do 高分得多！
example: Teenagers should engage in regular outdoor sports instead of spending all day playing video games.

def_zh: 促成；有助於；對…作出貢獻；捐助
def_en: to help to cause or bring about something, or to give something, especially money, in order to provide or achieve something together with other people
prep_trap: DSE 必考介詞陷阱！contribute to 中的 to 是介詞，若後接動詞，必須用動名詞 V-ing（contribute to improving air quality）！此外 make a contribution to 亦同。
example: Every citizen can contribute to protecting the environment by reducing single-use plastic consumption.

def_zh: 奉獻；把（時間或精力）投入於
def_en: to give all of your energy, time, etc.
prep_trap: 與 contribute to 一樣，dedicate oneself/time to 中的 to 是介詞，後接動詞必須用 V-ing（be dedicated to helping the needy）！
example: Many retired professionals dedicate their spare time to mentoring underprivileged youths in the community.

def_zh: 將（時間、精力或一生）奉獻給；專注於
def_en: to give your time or effort completely to something you believe in or to a person
prep_trap: DSE 改錯題常客！devote time/effort/oneself to 後面的 to 是介詞，後面必須接名詞或 V-ing（devote more time to reading），絕對不可接原形動詞！
example: Parents should devote more quality time to communicating with their children every evening.

def_zh: 承諾；投入（加 to）；犯（罪、錯）
def_en: to promise or give your loyalty, time, or money to a particular principle, person, or plan of action, or to do something illegal
prep_trap: 過去式雙寫 tt（committed）；正面用法 be committed to V-ing（致力於…，to 是介詞）；負面用法直接接罪行（commit a crime / commit suicide）。
example: Our school is fully committed to providing a safe and inclusive learning environment for all.

def_zh: 適應（新環境或變化）；改編
def_en: to change your behaviour so that it is easier to live in a particular place or situation
prep_trap: 極易與 adopt（採納/領養）混淆！記法：a-dapt 中間是 a（adapt to a new environment 適應新環境，to 是介詞）。
example: Orientation programmes help Secondary One freshmen adapt to the new secondary school environment quickly.

def_zh: 採取（態度、方法或政策）；養成（健康生活模式）；領養
def_en: to start to use a particular method or to show a particular attitude towards somebody or something, or to legally take a child into your family
prep_trap: 與 adapt 不同，a-dopt 中間是 o，是及物動詞，不加 to！DSE 萬用搭配：adopt a healthy lifestyle / adopt a positive attitude / adopt green practices。
example: Citizens are encouraged to adopt a low-carbon lifestyle by taking public transport more frequently.

def_zh: 調整；調節；適應（加 to）
def_en: to change something slightly, especially to make it more correct, effective, or suitable, or to become more familiar with a new situation
prep_trap: 作及物動詞解「調整（時間表/心態）」（adjust the schedule）；作不及物動詞加 to 解「適應」（adjust to university life）。
example: Exchange students may need a few weeks to adjust to the local weather and diet.

def_zh: 適應（新氣候、時差或陌生環境）
def_en: to change to suit different conditions of life, weather, etc.
prep_trap: 內含 climate（氣候）：注意雙寫 cc（ac-cli-ma-tize），後接介詞 to。
example: Athletes arrived in London two weeks early to acclimatize to the cold weather and time difference.

def_zh: 融入（社群或社會）；將…結合/納入
def_en: to mix with and join society or a group of people, often changing to suit their way of life, or to combine two things
prep_trap: 少數族裔或新移民題必備：融入社會介詞用 integrate into society；將科技融入課堂用 integrate technology into classroom teaching。
example: Language support classes help ethnic minority students integrate into the local community more smoothly.

def_zh: 同化；融入（主流文化）；吸收（新知識）
def_en: to become part of a group, country, society, etc., or to understand and remember new information
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 ss（as-sim-i-late）；融入新文化用 assimilate into a new culture。
example: Learning Cantonese is crucial for new immigrants who wish to assimilate into Hong Kong society.

def_zh: 合作；配合；協作
def_en: to act or work together for a particular purpose, or to be helpful by doing what someone asks you to do
prep_trap: 注意開頭雙 o（co-op-er-ate）；與某人合作介詞用 cooperate with sb。
example: Playing team sports teaches children how to cooperate with teammates to achieve a common goal.

def_zh: 協作；合著；共同研究（項目）
def_en: to work together with somebody in order to produce or achieve something
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 ll（col-lab-o-rate）；與某人就某項目合作：collaborate with sb on a project（人配 with，項目配 on）。
example: Students are required to collaborate with three classmates on a science research project this term.

def_zh: 統籌；協調（多方工作或行動）
def_en: to make many different things work effectively as a whole
prep_trap: 注意開頭雙 o（co-or-di-nate）；及物動詞，常搭配 relief efforts / activities / different departments。
example: A teacher advisor was appointed to coordinate the joint-school charity bazaar with partner schools.

def_zh: 互動；交流；互相影響
def_en: to communicate with or react to each other
prep_trap: 不及物動詞，與某人互動必須加介詞 with（interact with peers face to face）。
example: Over-reliance on smartphones reduces opportunities for teenagers to interact with family members face to face.

def_zh: 溝通；交流；傳達（想法或感情）
def_en: to share information with others by speaking, writing, moving your body, or using other signals
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 mm：與某人溝通必須加介詞 with（communicate with parents）；若直接接訊息/想法（communicate ideas）則不加 with。
example: Learning a foreign language enables young people to communicate effectively with people from diverse backgrounds.

def_zh: 傳達；表達（訊息、感情、謝意或寓意）
def_en: to express a thought, feeling, or idea so that it is understood by other people
prep_trap: 替換 express / show 的高分及物動詞：注意字尾是 -vey（con-vey）；向某人傳達訊息用 convey a message to sb。
example: Through this poster competition, we hope to convey a strong anti-bullying message to all students.

def_zh: 表達；抒發（意見、感受或關切）
def_en: to show a feeling, opinion, or fact
prep_trap: 及物動詞，直接接 opinions / gratitude / concern，切勿寫成 express about my opinion！
example: I am writing to express my deep concern over the worsening air pollution in Hong Kong.

def_zh: 公開表達；吐露（不滿、意見或憂慮）
def_en: to tell people your opinions or feelings about a particular subject
prep_trap: Letter to the Editor 開頭萬用動詞！voice 作及物動詞解「公開表達（不滿或意見）」：voice one's opinions / grievances / concerns。
example: Many residents attended the town hall forum to voice their strong opposition to the reclamation project.

def_zh: 清晰地表達（想法或觀點）；口齒伶俐的
def_en: to express thoughts and feelings easily and clearly
prep_trap: 辯論或語言學習題高分詞：及物動詞，直接接 thoughts / ideas / arguments。
example: Joining the debate team trains students to think critically and articulate their arguments persuasively.

def_zh: 談判；磋商；議價
def_en: to have formal discussions with someone in order to reach an agreement with them
prep_trap: 注意中間是 -ti-（ne-go-ti-ate）；與供應商議價用 negotiate with the supplier for a better discount。
example: Our treasurer successfully negotiated with the coach company for a ten percent group discount.

def_zh: 說服；勸說
def_en: to make someone do or believe something by giving them a good reason to do it
prep_trap: 注意開頭是 per-（與 pursue 的 pur- 相反），中間有 u（per-suade）；句型為 persuade sb to do sth 或 persuade sb into V-ing。
example: Clever television advertisements are designed to persuade young consumers to buy the latest smartphones.

def_zh: 使信服；使確信；說服
def_en: to persuade someone or make someone certain
prep_trap: 必考句型：convince sb of sth / convince sb that... / convince sb to do sth；被動語態 I am convinced that...（我深信…，替換 I strongly believe）。
example: I am firmly convinced that education is the key to breaking the cycle of poverty.

def_zh: 敦促；力勸；強烈要求
def_en: to strongly advise or try to persuade someone to do a particular thing
prep_trap: Letter to the Editor 結尾呼籲政府行動必用：I strongly urge the government to...（句型為 urge sb to do sth）。
example: Concern groups strongly urge the government to build more public clinics in remote districts.

def_zh: 呼籲；懇請；對…有吸引力
def_en: to make a serious or formal request, especially to the public, or to interest or attract someone
prep_trap: 兩大核心用法皆配介詞 to：1. 吸引某人：appeal to young people（切勿用被動語態！）；2. 呼籲某人做某事：appeal to the public to donate money。
example: Interactive learning games appeal to primary students much more than traditional rote memorization.

def_zh: 吸引（遊客、人才或注意）
def_en: to pull or draw someone or something towards them, by the qualities they have, especially good ones
prep_trap: 與 appeal to 不同，attract 是及物動詞，直接接人或注意（attract tourists / attract public attention），絕對不可加 to！
example: Hosting international mega-events can attract millions of overseas tourists and boost the local economy.

def_zh: 深深吸引；迷住（觀眾或讀者）
def_en: to hold the attention of someone by being extremely interesting, exciting, pleasant, or attractive
prep_trap: 書評、影評或活動報告替換 attract 的高分詞：直接接 audiences / readers，被動語態配 by（be captivated by）。
example: The magician's breathtaking performance captivated the entire audience at the variety show yesterday.

def_zh: 使著迷；深深吸引
def_en: to interest someone a lot
prep_trap: 注意開頭有 sc（fas-ci-nate，c 不發音）！以人作主語時必須用被動語態 + by（Students are fascinated by astronomy）。
example: Young children are always fascinated by the colourful marine life at Ocean Park.

def_zh: 啟迪；開導；使明白（真相或道理）
def_en: to provide someone with information and understanding, or to explain the true facts about something to someone
prep_trap: 由 en- + light + -en 構成；形容詞 enlightening（極具啟發性的，如 an enlightening talk）在感謝信中極好用。
example: The guest speaker delivered an enlightening talk that deepened our understanding of artificial intelligence.

def_zh: 教育；教導（公眾或學生）
def_en: to teach someone, especially using the formal system of school, college, or university
prep_trap: 建議段萬用句型：就某議題教育公眾，介詞搭配為 educate the public on/about food waste。
example: The government should launch television announcements to educate the public on proper waste separation.

def_zh: 推廣；促進；提倡；晉升
def_en: to encourage people to like, buy, use, do, or support something, or to raise someone to a higher position
prep_trap: 及物動詞，直接接抽象名詞（promote mental health / promote green living / promote social harmony），切勿寫 promote students to do（那是 encourage）！
example: The Department of Health has organized a citywide campaign to promote regular physical exercise.

def_zh: 普及；推廣；使大眾化
def_en: to make something become popular or easy for ordinary people to understand
prep_trap: 由 popular + -ize 構成（英式亦作 popularise）；常用於普及綠色科技、電子支付或某項運動（popularize electric vehicles）。
example: Building more charging stations across the city will help popularize the use of electric vehicles.

def_zh: 善用；利用（資源、空間或科技）
def_en: to use something in an effective way
prep_trap: 替換 use 的正式及物動詞：開頭雖是 u 但發 /juː/ 音；直接接 resources / renewable energy / spare time。
example: Schools should fully utilize interactive learning apps to make language lessons more engaging.

def_zh: 剝削（勞工或弱勢）；開發；充分利用（潛能）
def_en: to use someone or something unfairly for your own advantage, or to use something well to gain as much from it as possible
prep_trap: 在社會議題中多帶強烈貶義，指「不公平地剝削」（exploit low-skilled workers / exploit loopholes 鑽法律漏洞）。
example: Unscrupulous employers must not be allowed to exploit part-time teenage workers by underpaying them.

def_zh: 操縱；擺佈（輿論、數據或他人）；熟練操作
def_en: to control something or someone to your advantage, often unfairly or dishonestly
prep_trap: 注意拼法為 ma-nip-u-late；常指社交媒體演算法或廣告商操縱消費者（manipulate public opinion / consumers）。
example: Social media algorithms are designed to capture our attention and subtly manipulate our buying behaviour.

def_zh: 主導；壟斷；支配（市場或日常生活）
def_en: to have control over a place or person, or to be the most important part of something
prep_trap: 及物動詞，直接接 the market / our daily lives，切勿加 over！被動語態配 by（be dominated by giant chains）。
example: Local shopping malls are increasingly dominated by large chain stores and luxury brands.

def_zh: 壟斷；獨佔（市場、資源或討論）
def_en: to have complete control over something so that other people cannot share it
prep_trap: 香港經濟與小店生存題必備（名詞為 monopoly 壟斷）：注意中間是三個 o（mo-nop-o-lize）。
example: When giant supermarkets monopolize the retail market, small family-run shops struggle to survive.

def_zh: 徹底改變；使轉型；把…改造成
def_en: to change completely the appearance or character of something or someone, especially so that that thing or person is improved
prep_trap: 替換 change 的高分動詞：把 A 改造成 B 搭配介詞 into（transform vacant school premises into transitional housing）。
example: The rapid development of artificial intelligence has transformed the way people work and learn.

def_zh: 徹底革新；使發生革命性巨變
def_en: to completely change something so that it is much better
prep_trap: 科技題首段開篇王牌動詞！及物動詞，直接接 education / healthcare / communication。
example: Smartphones and high-speed Internet have revolutionized modern communication over the past two decades.

def_zh: 使現代化；更新（設施或系統）
def_en: to make a system, methods, etc. more modern and more suitable for use at the present time
prep_trap: 由 modern + -ize 構成；常搭配 school facilities / public transport / infrastructure。
example: The school has received a government grant to modernize its ageing science laboratories.

def_zh: 活化（古蹟或舊區）；重振（經濟或傳統行業）
def_en: to give new life, energy, activity, or success to something
prep_trap: 香港市區重建及保育題必考神字（活化歷史建築 revitalize historic buildings）：內含 vital（生命力）。
example: The government plans to revitalize the old factory building into a creative arts centre.

def_zh: 使（更生人士或成癮者）改過自新 / 康復；修復
def_en: to return someone or something to a good or healthy condition, state, or way of living
prep_trap: 青少年犯罪或健康題高分詞（名詞為 rehabilitation 康復/更生服務）：注意拼法為 re-ha-bil-i-tate。
example: Community support programmes play a vital role in helping young offenders rehabilitate and reintegrate.

def_zh: 恢復（信心、秩序或健康）；修復（古蹟或生態）
def_en: to return something or someone to an earlier good condition or position
prep_trap: 恢復公眾對某事的信心，介詞搭配為 restore public confidence in。
example: Strict quality inspections are necessary to restore consumer confidence in local food products.

def_zh: 補充（體力、水分、能量或庫存）
def_en: to fill something up again
prep_trap: 健康與運動題高分詞（內含 plenty 充足的字根）：運動後補充水分與體力用 replenish water and energy。
example: Long-distance runners must drink sports beverages regularly to replenish lost water and electrolytes.

def_zh: 補償；賠償；彌補（損失或不足）
def_en: to pay someone money in exchange for something that has been lost or damaged, or to provide something good to balance something bad
prep_trap: DSE 必考介詞搭配：彌補某項損失或缺陷，必須加介詞 for（compensate for the lack of experience = make up for）！
example: Buying expensive toys cannot compensate for a lack of parental love and companionship.

def_zh: 抵銷；彌補（碳排放、額外成本或負面影響）
def_en: to balance one influence against an opposing influence, so that there is no great difference as a result
prep_trap: 過去式及過去分詞皆為 offset（三態同形！）；環保題常用 offset carbon emissions（抵銷碳排放）。
example: Airlines allow passengers to pay a small fee to plant trees and offset carbon emissions.

def_zh: （優點或弊端）大於；重於；勝過
def_en: to be greater or more important than something else
prep_trap: DSE 正反議論文總結段必背黃金句型：The benefits of X far outweigh its drawbacks（X 的好處遠大於其壞處，注意 weigh 拼法含 eigh）！
example: All in all, the long-term benefits of building a recycling plant far outweigh its costs.

def_zh: 超越；勝過；超過（預期或紀錄）
def_en: to do or be better than ever before, or better than someone else
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 ss（sur-pass）；及物動詞，常搭配 expectations / previous records / human intelligence。
example: The total amount of donations raised at the charity gala far surpassed our expectations.

def_zh: 超過；超出（預算、限速、字數或標準）
def_en: to be greater than a number or amount, or to go past an allowed limit
prep_trap: 注意字尾是 -ceed（雙 ee，英語中僅有 succeed / proceed / exceed 三個常用字以 -ceed 結尾）；及物動詞，直接接 the budget / the limit，不加 over！
example: Entries for the short story writing competition must not exceed five hundred words.

def_zh: 繼續進行（加 with）；前往（加 to）
def_en: to continue as planned, or to move in a particular direction
prep_trap: 注意開頭是 pro-，字尾是雙 ee（pro-ceed，切勿與意為「在…之前」的 precede 混淆）；繼續執行某計劃用 proceed with the plan，前往禮堂用 proceed to the hall。
example: Upon arrival, all guests should proceed directly to the auditorium on the second floor.

def_zh: 成功做到（加 in）；繼任
def_en: to achieve something that you have been aiming for
prep_trap: 極高頻詞性與介詞錯誤！succeed 是動詞（切勿寫 I am succeed，那是形容詞 successful）！且「成功做某事」必須用 succeed in V-ing（絕對不可寫 succeed to do）！
example: Only those who work hard and stay humble will ultimately succeed in achieving their goals.

def_zh: 蓬勃發展；興旺；茁壯成長
def_en: to grow or develop successfully
prep_trap: 不及物動詞（無被動語態），注意開頭是 flour-；常用於形容文化、藝術、小店或學生在良好環境下茁壯成長。
example: With government funding and public support, local independent music and arts can truly flourish.

def_zh: 茁壯成長；興盛；蓬勃發展
def_en: to grow, develop, or be successful
prep_trap: 不及物動詞，現在分詞 thriving 極常作形容詞修飾城市或行業（a thriving tourist hub 蓬勃的旅遊樞紐）。
example: Children thrive best when they grow up in a loving and supportive family environment.

def_zh: 繁榮；昌盛；成功
def_en: to be or become successful, especially financially
prep_trap: 不及物動詞（名詞為 prosperity 繁榮，形容詞為 prosperous 繁榮的）。
example: Maintaining social stability and the rule of law helps Hong Kong prosper as a financial centre.

def_zh: 加速；加快（發展、步伐或全球暖化）
def_en: to happen or make something happen sooner or faster
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 cc，單寫 l（ac-cel-er-ate）；可作及物或不及物動詞（accelerate the pace of... 加快…的步伐）。
example: The pandemic has significantly accelerated the adoption of online learning and remote work worldwide.

def_zh: 激增；迅速蔓延；大量湧現
def_en: to increase a lot and suddenly in number
prep_trap: 不及物動詞（名詞為 proliferation），用來形容短片平台、網購或假新聞迅速氾濫。
example: With the proliferation of smartphones, teenagers can access social media anytime and anywhere.

def_zh: 急升；暴漲；飆升（樓價、物價或壓力）
def_en: to rise extremely quickly or make extremely quick progress towards success
prep_trap: 不及物動詞，生動替換 increase sharply！常以 property prices / living costs 作主語，或用現在分詞 skyrocketing rents（飆升的租金）。
example: Many small local restaurants have been forced to close down due to skyrocketing rents.

def_zh: 猛增；高漲；飆升（氣溫、樓價或需求）
def_en: to rise very quickly to a high level
prep_trap: 注意拼法為 s-o-a-r（切勿與意為「酸痛的」sore 或「酸的」sour 混淆）；不及物動詞，常作 soaring temperatures / soaring housing prices。
example: Soaring housing prices have made it almost impossible for young graduates to buy a flat.

def_zh: 急劇上升；激增；湧現
def_en: a sudden and great increase, or to increase suddenly and strongly
prep_trap: 作名詞時，表示「某事物的激增」後面介詞必須用 in（a sudden surge in youth crime / flu cases）！
example: Hospitals are facing immense pressure due to a sudden surge in seasonal influenza cases.

def_zh: （衝突、危機或成本）逐步升級；不斷惡化
def_en: to become or make something become greater or more serious
prep_trap: 與 escalator（扶手電梯）同源：專門指衝突、緊張局勢或開支「節節上升、愈演愈烈」（escalate into a major crisis）。
example: Minor arguments on social media can easily escalate into serious cyberbullying and real-life conflicts.

def_zh: 暴跌；急劇下降（出生率、氣溫或銷量）
def_en: to fall very quickly and suddenly
prep_trap: soar / skyrocket 的反義詞：注意雙寫 mm（plum-met），不及物動詞，替換 drop sharply 的高分詞。
example: Hong Kong's birth rate has plummeted to a record low over the past decade.

def_zh: 驟降；暴跌；使陷入（危機或困境）
def_en: to become lower in value or level very suddenly and quickly, or to move or fall suddenly
prep_trap: 作名詞時配介詞 in（a sharp plunge in tourist arrivals）；作動詞亦可指陷入困境（plunge into poverty）。
example: The sudden closure of the factory plunged hundreds of grassroots families into financial hardship.

def_zh: 逐漸減少；日趨枯竭（自然資源、人口或支持度）
def_en: to become smaller in size or amount, or fewer in number
prep_trap: 不及物動詞，常以現在分詞 dwindling 修飾名詞（dwindling natural resources 日漸枯竭的自然資源）。
example: Developing renewable energy is urgent because global reserves of fossil fuels are rapidly dwindling.

def_zh: 削弱；減少；降低（重要性、影響力或價值）
def_en: to reduce or be reduced in size or importance
prep_trap: 注意中間是兩個 i（di-min-ish，與 mini 同源）；可作及物或不及物動詞。
example: The rise of e-books has not diminished the value of public libraries in our community.

def_zh: 耗盡；使枯竭（天然資源、臭氧層或儲蓄）
def_en: to reduce something in size or amount, especially supplies of energy, money, etc.
prep_trap: 環保題核心動詞（名詞為 depletion）：及物動詞，常搭配 natural resources / the ozone layer / fish stocks。
example: Overfishing and marine pollution are depleting fish stocks in the South China Sea.

def_zh: 耗盡（資源或心力）；使筋疲力盡；汽車廢氣（名詞）
def_en: to make someone extremely tired, or to use something completely, or waste gases from an engine
prep_trap: 注意中間有不發音的 h（ex-haust）；作名詞時 exhaust fumes 指「汽車排出的廢氣」（環保題必考！）。
example: Exhaust fumes emitted by diesel vehicles are the primary source of roadside air pollution.

def_zh: 消耗（能源或時間）；進食；飲用；消費
def_en: to use fuel, energy, or time, especially in large amounts, or to eat or drink something
prep_trap: 在健康飲食題中，consume 是替換 eat / drink 最正式的動詞（consume excessive sugar）；在環保題則指消耗能源（consume electricity）。
example: Teenagers who consume sugary soft drinks every day face a much higher risk of obesity.

def_zh: 產生（電力、廢物、收入或討論）
def_en: to cause something to exist; to produce energy, waste, income, or interest
prep_trap: 替換 make / produce 的高分萬用及物動詞：可搭配正反名詞，如 generate renewable energy（發電）、generate municipal solid waste（產生都市固體廢物）或 generate revenue（創造收入）。
example: Hong Kong households generate thousands of tonnes of municipal solid waste every single day.

def_zh: 排放；散發（溫室氣體、廢氣、熱力或藍光）
def_en: to send out a beam, noise, smell, or gas
prep_trap: 過去式及過去分詞必須雙寫 tt（emitted / emitting）！名詞為 emission（carbon emissions 碳排放）；切勿與意為「遺漏」的 omit 混淆。
example: Coal-fired power plants emit massive amounts of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere every day.

def_zh: 排放（污水或化學廢料）；准許（病人）出院
def_en: to send out a substance, especially waste liquid or gas, or to allow a patient to leave hospital
prep_trap: emit 多指氣體/光，而 discharge 則專門指工廠「排放污水或液體廢料」（discharge untreated sewage into rivers）；在醫療題則指獲准出院（be discharged from hospital）。
example: Factories that illegally discharge untreated chemical waste into rivers must be heavily penalized.

def_zh: 污染；弄髒（水源、食物或土壤）
def_en: to make something less pure or make it poisonous
prep_trap: 比 pollute 更精準：專門指細菌、有毒化學物或重金屬滲入「水源、食物或土壤」使其有毒或不潔（contaminated water / food）。
example: Toxic chemicals leaking from landfills can contaminate underground water and threaten public health.

def_zh: 丟棄；處理；清除（垃圾或廢物）
def_en: to get rid of someone or something, especially by throwing it away
prep_trap: DSE 環保題必考介詞陷阱！dispose 是不及物動詞，後面必須加介詞 of 才可接廢物（dispose of household waste properly），千萬不可漏掉 of！
example: Citizens should learn how to sort and dispose of recyclable waste properly at home.

def_zh: 丟棄；拋棄（不需要的舊物或食物）
def_en: to throw something away or get rid of it because you no longer want or need it
prep_trap: 與 dispose of 不同，discard 是及物動詞，直接接物品（discard unwanted clothes），絕對不可加 of！
example: Fast fashion encourages consumers to buy cheap clothes and discard them after wearing them once.

def_zh: 累積；積聚（經驗、財富、知識或垃圾）
def_en: to collect a large number of things over a long period of time, or to gradually increase in amount
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 cc（ac-cu-mu-late）；替換 get experience 的高分搭配：accumulate valuable working experience（累積寶貴工作經驗）。
example: Doing part-time jobs during summer holidays helps students accumulate valuable real-world work experience.

def_zh: 擴大；擴展（社交圈子、詞彙量或業務）
def_en: to increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way
prep_trap: 極易與 expend（花費，中間是 e）及 extend（延長時間/期限）混淆！expand（中間是 a）指「面積、規模、社交圈或知識面的擴大」（expand one's social circle）。
example: Joining volunteer services is a great way for teenagers to expand their social circle.

def_zh: 延長（開放時間或截止日期）；向…致以（感謝或歡迎）
def_en: to make something last longer or make it bigger, or to offer something formally to someone
prep_trap: Paper 3 兩大必考用法：1. 延長時間/期限：extend the library opening hours / deadline；2. 演講或信件致意：extend a warm welcome / our heartfelt gratitude to。
example: Many students suggested that the school should extend the library opening hours during exam periods.

def_zh: 延長；拉長（壽命、痛苦或屏幕使用時間）
def_en: to make something last a longer time
prep_trap: 過去分詞 prolonged 極常作形容詞，指「長時間持續的（通常帶來不良後果）」，如 prolonged use of smartphones / prolonged sitting。
example: Prolonged use of computers without taking breaks can lead to severe neck and back pain.

def_zh: 縮短（輪候時間、工時或距離）
def_en: to become shorter or to make something shorter
prep_trap: 由形容詞 short 加動詞後綴 -en 構成（注意不可把形容詞 short 直接當動詞用！）；常搭配 waiting time / working hours。
example: Hiring more doctors in public hospitals will help shorten the long waiting time for patients.

def_zh: 擴闊（道路或眼界）；拉闊（貧富差距或代溝）
def_en: to become wider, or to make something wider
prep_trap: 由 wide 去 e 加 -en 構成；社會議題常寫 widen the wealth gap（拉闊貧富差距）或 widen the generation gap（加深代溝）。
example: Unequal access to quality tutoring services may further widen the gap between rich and poor students.

def_zh: 收窄；縮小（差距、分歧或貧富懸殊）；狹窄的
def_en: to become narrower or to make something narrower, especially a gap or difference
prep_trap: narrow 本身即可作動詞（切勿加 -en 寫成 narrowen）！搭配 gap 時與 bridge the gap 同義（narrow the wealth gap 收窄貧富差距）。
example: Providing free laptops to grassroots students helps narrow the digital divide in online learning.

def_zh: 彌合；消除；拉近（代溝、差距或文化隔閡）
def_en: to make the difference or division between two things smaller or less severe
prep_trap: DSE 作文滿分動詞搭配：bridge the gap between A and B（拉近 A 與 B 之間的距離/消除代溝 bridge the generation gap）。
example: Doing volunteer work with the elderly can effectively bridge the generation gap in our society.

def_zh: 加深（理解、認識或矛盾）
def_en: to make a feeling, knowledge, or relationship stronger or more intense
prep_trap: 由 deep + -en 構成；文化交流或參觀考察題必備：deepen students' understanding of Chinese history（加深學生對…的認識）。
example: Visiting historical museums in Beijing deepened students' understanding of traditional Chinese culture and history.

def_zh: 提高；增強（意識、警覺性或緊張氣氛）
def_en: to increase or make something increase, especially an emotion or effect
prep_trap: 注意由名詞 height 加 -en 構成（height-en，切勿拼成 high-ten）！常作為 raise public awareness 的高階替代（heighten public awareness of）。
example: Regular fire drills at school help heighten students' awareness of safety and emergency procedures.

def_zh: 減輕；減少（負擔、痛楚或影響）
def_en: to become less, or to make something less
prep_trap: 極易與名詞 lesson（課堂/教訓，字尾 -on）混淆！動詞 lessen 字尾是 -en（由 less + -en 構成）。
example: Subsidizing textbook fees can help lessen the financial burden on low-income families.

def_zh: 紓緩；減輕（壓力、焦慮、痛楚或交通擠塞）
def_en: to make an unpleasant feeling, such as pain or worry, less strong
prep_trap: 注意 i 在 e 前（re-lieve，如同 believe），名詞為 relief（f 結尾）！DSE 最常搭配 relieve stress / pressure / traffic congestion。
example: Listening to soothing music and jogging in the park are effective ways to relieve stress.

def_zh: 安撫；舒緩（緊張情緒、疲勞或痛楚）
def_en: to make someone feel calm or less worried, or to make a painful part of the body feel more comfortable
prep_trap: 注意字尾有 e（soothe，讀 /suːð/）；現在分詞 soothing（令人放鬆舒緩的）極常修飾 music / environment。
example: Drinking a cup of warm chamomile tea before bed can help soothe frayed nerves.

def_zh: 減輕；緩和（財政負擔、短缺或擠迫）；輕鬆自在（名詞）
def_en: to make or become less severe, difficult, unpleasant, painful, etc.
prep_trap: 作動詞時直接接 the burden / traffic congestion / labour shortage；作名詞時，feel at ease 解作「感到自在放鬆」，with ease 解作「輕易地」。
example: Importing skilled workers from overseas can help ease the severe labour shortage in the construction sector.

def_zh: 安撫；平息（憤怒的顧客、哭鬧的孩童或民憤）
def_en: to cause someone who is angry or upset to be calm and satisfied
prep_trap: Paper 3 處理投訴及育兒題好用詞：注意拼法為 pac-i-fy（與 peace 同源）。
example: Many parents give smartphones to young children in restaurants simply to pacify them quickly.

def_zh: 安慰；撫慰（傷心或失落的人）
def_en: to make someone who is sad or disappointed feel better, usually by giving them comfort or sympathy
prep_trap: 作動詞「安慰」時重音在第二音節（/kənˈsəʊl/）；若重音在第一音節作名詞（game console）則解作「遊戲機主機」。
example: True friends will always stand by your side and console you when you face failure.

def_zh: 有同理心；感同身受；體諒
def_en: to be able to understand how someone else feels
basic_word: understand / put oneself in others' shoes
prep_trap: 名詞為 empathy（同理心）：動詞 empathize 是不及物動詞，對某人感同身受必須加介詞 with（empathize with the underprivileged）。
example: Participating in poverty simulation workshops helps affluent students empathize with grassroots families.

def_zh: 同情；憐憫；支持
def_en: to understand and care about someone's problems
prep_trap: 注意開頭有 y（sym-pa-thize），不及物動詞，必須搭配介詞 with（sympathize with the victims）。
example: While we sympathize with small shop owners, street obstruction cannot be tolerated for safety reasons.

def_zh: 珍惜；珍視（親情、友誼、機會或和平）
def_en: to love, protect, and care for someone or something that is important to you
prep_trap: DSE 記敘文及演講稿感性收結必備動詞！注意單寫 r（cher-ish），直接接賓語。
example: Graduating students should cherish the precious memories and friendships they have built at school.

def_zh: 珍視；珍惜（動詞）；寶藏（名詞）
def_en: to take great care of something because you love it or consider it very valuable
prep_trap: 除了作名詞「寶物」，在寫作中作及物動詞解「珍惜（機會/關係）」極自然地道（treasure family time）。
example: Busy city dwellers should learn to slow down and treasure the time spent with family.

def_zh: 尊重；尊敬；方面（名詞）
def_en: admiration felt or shown for someone or something that you believe has good ideas or qualities
prep_trap: 作名詞指「尊重」時不可數（show respect for elders）；但若加 -s（in many respects）則解作「在許多方面（= in many aspects）」！
example: A harmonious society is built upon mutual respect and tolerance among different ethnic groups.

def_zh: 容忍；包容；忍受
def_en: to accept behaviour and beliefs that are different from your own, or to deal with something unpleasant
prep_trap: 及物動詞（名詞為 tolerance 包容，形容詞為 tolerant）；若後接動詞，必須用動名詞 V-ing（cannot tolerate being bullied）。
example: Schools must adopt a zero-tolerance policy towards all forms of campus bullying and discrimination.

def_zh: 迎合；照顧；滿足（某群體的需要或興趣）
def_en: to provide what is wanted or needed by someone or something
prep_trap: DSE 必考介詞搭配：cater 是不及物動詞，必須搭配介詞 for 或 to（cater for students of different abilities 照顧不同能力學生的需要）！
example: The summer carnival offers a wide variety of booth games to cater for all ages.

def_zh: 滿足（需求、好奇心或條件）；使滿意
def_en: to please someone by giving them what they want or need, or to have or provide something that is needed
prep_trap: 注意拼法為 sat-is-fy；表示「對…感到滿意」必須用被動結構 + 介詞 with（be satisfied with the service）。
example: Building more public housing estates is the only way to satisfy the huge housing demand.

def_zh: 實現（夢想或潛能）；履行（責任）；符合（要求）
def_en: to do something that is expected, hoped for, or promised, or to cause it to happen
prep_trap: 英式拼法為兩個單 l（ful-fil，美式亦作 fulfill），過去式雙寫 ll（fulfilled）；常搭配 potential / dream / responsibility / requirement。
example: A supportive school environment enables every student to discover their strengths and fulfil their potential.

def_zh: 遵守；服從；依從（法例、規則或要求）
def_en: to act according to an order, set of rules, or request
prep_trap: 替換 follow the rules 的滿分正式動詞！注意是不及物動詞，後面必須加介詞 with（comply with safety regulations）！
example: All restaurants must strictly comply with food hygiene regulations to ensure customer safety.

def_zh: 遵守；信守（法律、校規或承諾）
def_en: to accept or obey an agreement, decision, or rule
prep_trap: 必考介詞搭配：與 comply with 不同，abide 後面必須配介詞 by（abide by the law 遵守法律 -> law-abiding citizens 守法市民）！
example: Visitors to country parks must abide by the rules and take their litter home.

def_zh: 嚴格遵守；堅持（原則、規定或時間表）
def_en: to continue to obey a rule or have a belief
prep_trap: 必考介詞搭配：comply 配 with，abide 配 by，而 adhere 則必須配介詞 to（strictly adhere to the guidelines）！
example: All competition participants must strictly adhere to the rules set by the organizing committee.

def_zh: 順從；迎合（社會規範或潮流）；符合（標準）
def_en: to behave according to the usual standards of behaviour that are expected by a group or society
prep_trap: 極易與 confirm（確認，中間是 i）混淆！con-form（中間是 o）後接介詞 to/with，青少年題常寫 conform to peer pressure / social norms。
example: Many teenagers feel immense pressure to conform to unrealistic beauty standards on social media.

def_zh: 違反（法律或規定）；侵犯（私隱或人權）
def_en: to break or act against something, especially a law, agreement, principle, or something that should be treated with respect
prep_trap: comply with 的反義詞：violate 是及物動詞，直接接 the law / school rules / privacy，不加介詞！
example: Secretly taking photos of others and posting them online seriously violates their personal privacy.

def_zh: 侵犯（版權、知識產權或個人權利）
def_en: to break a rule, law, etc., or to limit someone's legal rights
prep_trap: 科技與創作題必考（名詞為 copyright infringement 侵犯版權）：可作及物動詞（infringe copyright）或加介詞 on/upon（infringe on personal freedom）。
example: Downloading pirated movies and music from illegal websites infringes the copyright of creators.

def_zh: 處罰；懲處；對…判罰（罰款或扣分）
def_en: to punish someone for breaking a law or rule
prep_trap: 替換 punish 的高分正式動詞（源自 penalty 罰則）：因某違規行為處罰某人，介詞用 penalize offenders for littering。
example: Students who submit their project reports after the deadline will be penalized by ten marks.

def_zh: 檢控；起訴；依法追究
def_en: to officially accuse someone of committing a crime in a law court
prep_trap: 香港法律告示常見詞（Offenders will be prosecuted 違例者將被檢控）：注意拼法為 pros-e-cute，切勿與意為「迫害」的 persecute 混淆！
example: Shopkeepers who sell alcohol or cigarettes to minors will be strictly prosecuted by the authorities.

def_zh: 規管；監管（行業或市場）；調節（情緒或體溫）
def_en: to control something, especially by making it work in a particular way or by using rules
prep_trap: 建議政府立例規管新興事物（如網購、外賣平台、美容業或 AI）的王牌及物動詞：strictly regulate online platforms。
example: The government should introduce new laws to strictly regulate the use of artificial intelligence.

def_zh: 監察；監督；跟進（進度、質素或子女上網情況）
def_en: to watch and check a situation carefully for a period of time in order to discover something about it
prep_trap: 注意字尾是 -tor（mon-i-tor）；在寫作中作及物動詞解「密切監察」（closely monitor children's online activities）。
example: Parents should closely monitor their children's internet usage to protect them from online scams.

def_zh: 監督；指導；管理（學生或工作人員）
def_en: to watch a person or activity to make certain that everything is done correctly, safely, etc.
prep_trap: 注意字尾固定為 -vise（su-per-vise，不可拼成 -ize）；及物動詞，常指老師或上司在場監督。
example: Two physical education teachers will be on duty to supervise students during the swimming gala.

def_zh: 巡查；視察；檢查（衛生、樓宇安全或設施）
def_en: to look at something or someone carefully in order to discover information, especially about their quality or condition
prep_trap: 替換 check 的正式動詞（名詞為 inspection）：常指政府部門定期巡查樓宇或食肆（regularly inspect old buildings）。
example: Government officials should regularly inspect old residential buildings to prevent concrete spalling accidents.

def_zh: 仔細審查；嚴格審視（帳目、申請或資訊真偽）
def_en: to examine something very carefully in order to discover information
prep_trap: 注意開頭為 scru-（名詞為 scrutiny 嚴密監督）；及物動詞，指一絲不苟地審查。
example: Internet users should carefully scrutinize the source of online news before sharing it with others.

def_zh: 核實；查證；證實（資料、身分或新聞真偽）
def_en: to prove that something exists or is true, or to make certain that something is correct
prep_trap: 假新聞與網絡素養題必考動詞：核實網上資訊的真偽（verify the authenticity of online information）。
example: Students must learn to verify the accuracy of information generated by artificial intelligence tools.

def_zh: 評估；檢討；評價（成效、表現或利弊）
def_en: to judge or calculate the quality, importance, amount, or value of something
prep_trap: 及物動詞，常搭配 effectiveness / academic performance / pros and cons。
example: The committee will conduct a survey to evaluate the effectiveness of the new recycling scheme.

def_zh: 評核（學生能力）；評估（影響、風險或損失）
def_en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something
prep_trap: 注意兩組雙 ss（as-sess），切勿與意為「進入/使用」的 access（ac-cess）混淆！
example: Written examinations alone cannot comprehensively assess a student's creativity and interpersonal skills.

def_zh: 接觸或使用的機會（名詞）；存取/查閱（動詞）
def_en: the method or possibility of getting near to a place or person, or the right to use or look at something
prep_trap: DSE 萬年語法大伏！1. 作動詞時是及物動詞，直接接資料（access the Internet / access information），絕對不可加 to！2. 作不可數名詞時（have access to information），後面才必須加介詞 to！
example: With the help of the Internet, students now have easy access to learning materials.

def_zh: 理解；領會；明白（深奧概念或文章）
def_en: to understand something completely
prep_trap: Reading Comprehension（閱讀理解）的動詞原形：替換 understand 的高分及物動詞。
example: Using visual diagrams in science lessons helps students comprehend complex abstract concepts more easily.

def_zh: 領會；掌握（知識或要點）；抓緊（機會）
def_en: to quickly take something in your hand(s) and hold it firmly, or to understand something, especially something difficult
prep_trap: 一詞兩用：1. 抓緊機會：grasp every opportunity；2. 掌握概念：grasp the main idea / have a good grasp of English。
example: Students should grasp every opportunity to practise speaking English both inside and outside the classroom.

def_zh: 把握；抓緊（機會或時機）；沒收
def_en: to take something quickly and keep or hold it, especially an opportunity
prep_trap: 極高頻拼錯字！違反 i before e 原則，必須是 e 在 i 前（s-e-i-z-e）！演講稿結尾常寫 seize the opportunity to（把握機會去…）。
example: Young people should step out of their comfort zone and seize every opportunity to learn.

def_zh: 精通；熟練掌握（語言、技術或情緒）
def_en: to learn how to do something well
prep_trap: 在教育題中作及物動詞解「徹底掌握（技能或外語）」（master a foreign language），比 learn 程度更高。
example: Consistent daily practice is the only secret to mastering a musical instrument or foreign language.

def_zh: 擅長於；在…方面表現卓越
def_en: to be extremely good at something
prep_trap: 注意原形單 l（ex-cel），過去式及現在分詞必須雙寫 ll（excelled / excelling）！不及物動詞，在某領域表現出色必須加介詞 in 或 at（excel in sports / academics）。
example: Every child has unique talents, and not everyone can excel in traditional academic examinations.

def_zh: 表現優於；勝過（同儕或對手）
def_en: to do well in a particular job or activity compared to others of a similar type
prep_trap: 由 out- + perform 一字連寫構成；及物動詞，直接接比較對象（outperform their peers）。
example: Studies show that students who get sufficient sleep consistently outperform those who stay up late.

def_zh: 專攻；專門研究或從事（某學科或專業）
def_en: to study or work on a particular subject or skill more than any others, so that you become an expert in it
prep_trap: 不及物動詞，後面必須加介詞 in（specialize in environmental science 專攻環境科學）。
example: After graduating from medical school, Chloe decided to specialize in child psychology and mental health.

def_zh: 專心；集中注意力（於…）
def_en: to direct your attention or your efforts towards a particular activity, subject, or problem
prep_trap: 集中精神於某事，後面必須搭配介詞 on（concentrate on lessons / studies）。
example: Skipping breakfast makes it difficult for students to concentrate on their lessons in the morning.

def_zh: 使分心；分散…的注意力
def_en: to make someone stop giving their attention to something
prep_trap: 必考介詞搭配：使某人從某事中分心，結構為 distract sb from sth/V-ing（distract students from their studies，介詞必用 from）！
example: Constant pop-up notifications from social media apps easily distract students from their revision.

def_zh: 妨礙；干擾（加 with）；干涉（加 in）
def_en: to involve yourself in a situation when your involvement is not wanted, or to prevent something from working effectively
prep_trap: 不及物動詞，切勿直接接賓語！在議論文表「妨礙/干擾睡眠或學習」時，必須配介詞 with（interfere with students' sleep / studies）。
example: Part-time jobs can teach teenagers financial management, provided that working hours do not interfere with their studies.

def_zh: 擾亂；打亂；中斷（課堂秩序、生理時鐘或交通）
def_en: to prevent something, especially a system, process, or event, from continuing as usual or as expected
prep_trap: 與 interfere with 不同，disrupt 是及物動詞，直接接 biological clock / classroom order / traffic services。
example: Blue light emitted by smartphones at night can disrupt our biological clock and cause insomnia.

def_zh: 打斷（談話或思緒）；使暫時中斷
def_en: to stop a person from speaking for a short period by something you say or do, or to stop a process temporarily
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 rr（in-ter-rupt）；名詞為 interruption（without interruption 不間斷地）。
example: During group discussions, candidates should listen politely and never interrupt others rudely.

def_zh: 介入；干預；調停（市場、欺凌事件或危機）
def_en: to intentionally become involved in a difficult situation in order to improve it or prevent it from getting worse
prep_trap: 不及物動詞（名詞為 intervention 及早介入 early intervention）：介入某情況介詞用 intervene in the housing market。
example: Teachers and social workers must intervene immediately whenever they spot signs of campus bullying.

def_zh: 調解；斡旋（糾紛或衝突）
def_en: to talk to two separate people or groups involved in a disagreement to try to help them to agree or find a solution
prep_trap: 校園朋輩調解計劃（Peer Mediation Scheme）常考詞：在雙方之間調解用 mediate between two parties。
example: Trained student prefects can help mediate minor disputes among junior form classmates peacefully.

def_zh: 調停；使和解；兼顧協調（兩個看似對立的目標，如保育與發展）
def_en: to find a way in which two situations or beliefs that are opposed to each other can agree and exist together
prep_trap: 高階論證動詞：兼顧經濟發展與環境保育用 reconcile economic development with environmental conservation（介詞配 with）。
example: Urban planners must find a way to reconcile economic growth with heritage conservation.

def_zh: 納入；將…包含在內；融入（元素或建議）
def_en: to include something as part of something larger
prep_trap: Paper 3 建議書與 Paper 2 必備高分詞！將 A（新元素）納入 B（課程或計劃）中：incorporate A into B（介詞用 into）。
example: Physical education teachers can incorporate fun team games into lessons to motivate inactive students.

def_zh: 涵蓋；包含；囊括（多個範疇或領域）
def_en: to include different types of things
prep_trap: 替換 include 的高階及物動詞：注意雙寫 ss（en-com-pass），直接接 a wide range of topics。
example: True education should encompass not only academic knowledge but also moral and physical development.

def_zh: 由…組成；包含；包括
def_en: to have things or people as parts or members; to consist of
basic_word: consist of / be made up of
prep_trap: 語法大陷阱！主動語態直接接組成部分，絕對不加 of（The committee comprises ten members = consists of ten members）！若用被動語態才可寫 be comprised of。
example: The judging panel comprises the school principal, two English teachers, and the student union president.

def_zh: 構成（威脅或罪行）；佔（某比例）
def_en: to be or be considered as something, or to form or make something
prep_trap: 與 comprise 方向相反：部分 + constitute + 整體（Senior citizens constitute 20% of the population）；亦常寫 constitute a threat to（對…構成威脅）。
example: Elderly people aged over sixty-five will soon constitute one-third of Hong Kong's total population.

def_zh: 佔（某百分比或比例）；解釋說明（均配 for）
def_en: to form the total of something, or to explain the reason for something
prep_trap: Paper 3 數據報告必背片語動詞 account for：1. 佔某比例：account for 45% of the respondents；2. 解釋某現象的原因：account for the drop in sales。此外 take...into account 解作「把…考慮在內」。
example: Food waste accounts for over thirty percent of the municipal solid waste in our landfills.

def_zh: 代表（學校或群體）；象徵；佔（某數據）
def_en: to speak, act, or be present officially for another person or people, or to be a sign or symbol of something
prep_trap: 及物動詞，直接接 our school / a significant increase，切勿寫成 represent for！
example: Ten outstanding athletes were chosen to represent our school in the inter-school track and field meet.

def_zh: 象徵；代表（某種精神或意義）
def_en: to represent something
prep_trap: 注意開頭有 y（sym-bol-ize）；及物動詞，直接接 unity / hope / harmony。
example: The torch relay at the opening ceremony symbolizes the passing on of our school spirit.

def_zh: 體現；具現化（精神、價值觀或美德）
def_en: to represent a quality or an idea exactly
prep_trap: 由 em- + body 構成（第三人稱單數為 embodies）；常用來讚揚歷史建築、傳統節日或模範人物體現了某種核心精神。
example: Traditional Chinese festivals embody the core values of family reunion, gratitude, and harmony.

def_zh: 以…為特徵；具有…的特點
def_en: to be typical of a person, place, or thing, or to describe their qualities
prep_trap: 注意開頭是 char-ac-ter-；在描寫香港社會或現代生活時，最常用被動語態：Modern city life is characterized by a fast pace and high stress（以節奏急促為特徵）。
example: Life in Hong Kong is often characterized by a fast-paced lifestyle and long working hours.

def_zh: 分辨；區分（真偽、是非或好壞）
def_en: to notice or understand the difference between two things, or to make one person or thing seem different from another
prep_trap: 必考兩種介詞搭配：1. distinguish between A and B；2. distinguish A from B（分辨事實與假新聞 distinguish fact from fake news）。
example: Media literacy education teaches students how to distinguish reliable news from online rumours.

def_zh: 區分；辨別；使有別於
def_en: to show or find the difference between things that are compared
prep_trap: 與 distinguish 用法相同：differentiate between right and wrong 或 differentiate A from B。
example: Parents play a crucial role in guiding young children to differentiate between right and wrong.

def_zh: 將…分類；歸類
def_en: to put people or things into groups with the same features
prep_trap: 注意中間是 e（cat-e-go-rize，源自 category）；把垃圾或問題分為幾類用 categorize A into B。
example: Recyclable materials are generally categorized into paper, plastics, metals, and glass bottles.

def_zh: 把…分級；把…列為（某類別或法定古蹟）
def_en: to divide things or people into groups according to their type
prep_trap: 把某事物列為某等級，被動結構配介詞 as（be classified as a declared monument 被列為法定古蹟）。
example: The century-old clock tower has been officially classified as a declared monument by the government.

def_zh: 將…與…聯繫起來；與…有關聯
def_en: to connect someone or something in your mind with someone or something else
prep_trap: DSE 萬用高分分詞短語：associated with（與…相關的）！用來後置修飾名詞極為精簡（如 health risks associated with obesity 與肥胖相關的健康風險）。
example: Many people are still unaware of the serious health risks associated with a sedentary lifestyle.

def_zh: 與…相互關聯；與…成正比
def_en: if two or more facts, numbers, etc. correlate or are correlated, there is a close connection between them
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 rr（cor-re-late）；學術味濃厚的動詞，常寫 A is closely correlated with B（A 與 B 密切相關）。
example: Research shows that a student's reading habit is closely correlated with their writing proficiency.

def_zh: （時間上）巧合同時發生；與…撞期（加 with）；意見一致
def_en: to happen at or near the same time, or to be the same or similar
prep_trap: Paper 3 解釋為何更改活動日期的必備高分動詞！不及物動詞，與考試或假期撞期必須加介詞 with（coincide with the mock examination）。
example: We had to reschedule the music contest because the original date coincided with the mock exam.

def_zh: （時間或活動）相撞；撞期；發生衝突
def_en: if two events clash, they happen at the same time in a way that is not convenient, or to fight/argue
prep_trap: Paper 3 篩選日程時間表（Timetable clash）最常聽到的字：與某活動撞期用 clash with another event。
example: I cannot attend Friday's drama rehearsal because it clashes with my mathematics tutorial class.

def_zh: 衝突；矛盾；爭執；與…相抵觸（動詞）
def_en: an active disagreement between people with opposing opinions or principles
prep_trap: 作名詞時重音在前，與某人發生衝突用 come into conflict with；作動詞時重音在後（/kənˈflɪkt/），與某事物抵觸用 conflict with。
example: Differences in lifestyle and values can sometimes lead to conflicts between roommates at university.

def_zh: 與…自相矛盾；反駁；與…相違背
def_en: to be so different from each other that one of them must be wrong, or to say the opposite of what someone else has said
prep_trap: 及物動詞，直接接賓語（contradict each other 互相矛盾）；形容詞為 contradictory（矛盾的）。
example: Cutting the environmental budget directly contradicts the government's promise to achieve carbon neutrality.

def_zh: 反對；反抗；抵制（計劃或法例）
def_en: to disagree with something or someone, often by speaking or fighting against it or them
prep_trap: DSE 必考語法陷阱！1. 主動語態 oppose 是及物動詞，直接接名詞或 V-ing（oppose the plan），絕對不加 to！2. 轉作被動/形容詞結構 be opposed to 時，後面的 to 則是介詞，必須接名詞或 V-ing（be strongly opposed to building the landfill）！
example: Many local residents are strongly opposed to turning the neighbourhood park into a car park.

def_zh: 反對；不贊成（必加介詞 to）
def_en: to feel or express opposition to or dislike of something or someone
prep_trap: 作動詞「反對」時重音在第二音節（/əbˈdʒekt/），且為不及物動詞，後面必須加介詞 to + 名詞/V-ing（object to raising bus fares）！
example: Commuters strongly object to the bus company's application to raise fares during an economic downturn.

def_zh: 正式批准（及物）；贊成/認可（加 of）
def_en: to officially accept a plan or request, or to have a positive opinion of someone or something
prep_trap: 兩種用法：1. 校長或機構「正式批核（預算/計劃）」時直接接賓語（approve the budget）；2. 家長或公眾「主觀贊成/認同（某行為）」時則必須加介詞 of（approve of teenagers dating）。
example: Not all traditional parents approve of their children pursuing a career in esports.

def_zh: 公開支持；認可（計劃）；（名人）代言（產品）
def_en: to make a public statement of your approval or support for something or someone, or to appear in an advertisement
prep_trap: 及物動詞，直接接 proposal / product；廣告與消費題常考明星代言（celebrities endorse luxury brands）。
example: Teenagers often blindly purchase trendy sneakers simply because they are endorsed by pop stars.

def_zh: （在辯論或讓步時）承認（對方某點屬實）；讓步
def_en: to admit, often unwillingly, that something is true
prep_trap: 注意字尾是 -cede（而非 -ceed）；駁論段高階動詞：Opponents may concede that...（反對者或許會承認…）。
example: Even critics of homework must concede that regular practice helps students consolidate basic knowledge.

def_zh: 駁斥；反駁；證明（某觀點或指控）錯誤
def_en: to say or prove that a person, statement, opinion, etc. is wrong or false
prep_trap: 駁論段直接反擊對方謬誤的王牌及物動詞：refute the misconception / argument / claim（直接接觀點，切勿接 to do）。
example: Scientific evidence has completely refuted the false claim that vaccines are harmful to children.

def_zh: 反駁；回擊（辯論對手的論點）
def_en: to argue that a statement or claim is not true
prep_trap: 過去式雙寫 tt（rebutted），名詞為 rebuttal（反駁論點，辯論隊常用詞）。
example: The debate captain calmly presented solid statistics to rebut the opposing team's main argument.

def_zh: 證明…正當合理；為…辯護；成為…的充分理由
def_en: to give or to be a good reason for something
prep_trap: 及物動詞，後接名詞或動名詞 V-ing（justify spending billions of dollars）；形容詞為 justifiable（合情合理的）。
example: Academic pressure can never justify cheating in examinations or plagiarizing others' assignments.

def_zh: 值得；需要（引起重視或採取行動）；使…顯得合理
def_en: to make a particular activity necessary
prep_trap: 注意雙寫 rr，字尾是 -ant（war-rant）；議論文高分結尾句：This pressing issue warrants immediate government attention（這迫切問題值得政府立即關注）。
example: The alarming rise in youth suicide rates warrants immediate attention from schools and parents.

def_zh: 應得；值得（讚賞、尊重、關注或懲罰）
def_en: to have earned or to be given something because of the way you have behaved or the qualities you have
prep_trap: 語法亮點：當主語是事物且後接動詞時，可用主動 V-ing 表示被動意義（This proposal deserves considering = deserves to be considered）。
example: Street cleaners who work tirelessly to keep our city hygienic truly deserve our respect.

def_zh: 假定；推測；想當然地認為
def_en: to believe something to be true because it is very likely, although you are not certain
prep_trap: 替換 think / guess 的正式動詞：常構成駁論起手句 Many people mistakenly presume that...（許多人錯誤地以為…）。
example: Many parents mistakenly presume that sending children to elite tutorial schools guarantees academic success.

def_zh: 將…視為；看待；察覺
def_en: to come to an opinion about something, or have a belief about something
prep_trap: 遵循 c 後接 ei 原則（per-ceive，名詞為 perception 看法）！必考搭配：perceive A as B / be perceived as（被視為…，替換 be seen as）。
example: Vocational education is still unfairly perceived by some traditional parents as an inferior choice.

def_zh: 把…視為（配 as）；關於（with regard to）；問候（regards）
def_en: to consider or have an opinion about something or someone
prep_trap: 三大必考陷阱：1. 把 A 視為 B 必須加 as（regard A as B）；2. 表「關於…」時是單數 With regard to（或 In regard to / Regarding，切勿加 -s！）；3. 僅在書信結尾表「問候」才加 -s（Best regards）。
example: Hong Kong is widely regarded as one of the safest and most vibrant cities in Asia.

def_zh: 認為；視為（正式書面語）
def_en: to consider or judge something in a particular way
prep_trap: 與 regard 不同，deem 後接形容詞補語時不加 as！最常以被動結構出現：be deemed necessary / inappropriate / unacceptable（被認為是必要的/不恰當的）。
example: Any promotional poster that is deemed inappropriate by the school will be removed immediately.

def_zh: 考慮（後接 V-ing）；認為
def_en: to spend time thinking about a possibility or making a decision, or to have a particular opinion
prep_trap: DSE 兩大高頻語法錯處：1. 表示「考慮做某事」時，後面必須接動名詞 V-ing（consider studying abroad），絕對不可接 to do！2. Consider 是及物動詞，絕對不可寫 consider about！
example: The government should seriously consider building more cycling tracks in new development areas.

def_zh: 深思熟慮；盤算考慮（做某事）；沉思
def_en: to spend time considering a possible future action, or to consider one particular thing for a long time in a serious and quiet way
prep_trap: consider 的高階替換詞，語法規則完全相同：後接動詞時必須用動名詞 V-ing（contemplate quitting his job）。
example: Many stressed urbanites have contemplated moving to the countryside for a slower pace of life.

def_zh: 預期；預料；期盼
def_en: to imagine or expect that something will happen
prep_trap: 替換 expect 的高分動詞：直接接名詞、V-ing 或 that 子句（We anticipate that over 500 guests will attend），切勿接 sb to do！
example: We anticipate that more than three hundred parents and students will attend the carnival.

def_zh: 預見；預料到（未來問題或趨勢）
def_en: to know about something before it happens
prep_trap: 過去式 foresaw，過去分詞 foreseen（如同 see）；形容詞為 foreseeable（in the foreseeable future 在可預見的將來）。
example: Due to unforeseen weather circumstances, the outdoor stargazing camp had to be cancelled.

def_zh: 預測；預言；預計
def_en: to say that an event or action will happen in the future, especially as a result of knowledge or experience
prep_trap: 及物動詞，常搭配科學家或專家對未來的預測（Scientists predict that sea levels will rise...）；形容詞 predictable 可解作「老套乏味的（情節）」。
example: Climate scientists predict that extreme heatwaves and typhoons will become more frequent in future.

def_zh: 推測；猜測（加 on/about）；投機炒賣（樓宇或股票）
def_en: to guess possible answers to a question when you do not have enough information to be certain, or to buy goods/property hoping to make a profit
prep_trap: 香港樓市題常考名詞 property speculation（樓宇投機炒賣）；作「猜測」解時配介詞 on/about。
example: The government introduced special stamp duties to curb short-term property speculation in the housing market.

def_zh: 估計；估算（費用、人數或時間）
def_en: to guess or calculate the cost, size, value, etc. of something
prep_trap: Paper 3 預算表與數據題必備：被動句型 It is estimated that...（據估計…）或過去分詞作定語 the estimated cost（預計費用）。
example: It is estimated that the renovation of the school swimming pool will cost two million dollars.

def_zh: 把…歸功於（owe A to B）；欠（債或人情）；由於（owing to）
def_en: to need to pay or give something to someone because they have lent money to you, or to have success because of someone
prep_trap: DSE 寫作高頻複合介詞：owing to（= due to / because of 由於…），後接名詞短語，切勿接完整句子！
collocations: owe a debt of gratitude to
example: Owing to the heavy rainstorm this morning, the outdoor charity walkathon has been postponed.

def_zh: 導致（result in）；由…造成（result from）；結果
def_en: to happen or exist because of something, or to cause a particular situation to happen
prep_trap: DSE 最常掉轉方向的介詞陷阱！1. A（原因）results in B（結果）= leads to；2. B（結果）results from A（原因）= is caused by！記法：in 是進入結果，from 是來自原因。
example: Prolonged exposure to loud music through earphones can result in permanent hearing loss.

def_zh: 導致；引起（配 to）；過著（某種生活）
def_en: to cause something to happen or exist, or to live a particular type of life
prep_trap: 過去式及過去分詞拼法為 led（絕對沒有 a，千萬別把鉛筆芯的名詞 lead 當過去式寫！）！兩大搭配：1. lead to（導致，to 是介詞）；2. lead a healthy/sedentary life（過著…的生活）。
example: Eating excessive junk food and lacking exercise will inevitably lead to obesity and diabetes.

def_zh: 構成；造成（威脅、危險、挑戰或風險）
def_en: to cause something, especially a problem or difficulty
prep_trap: DSE 議論文必背黃金搭配：pose a serious threat/risk/challenge/hazard to sb/sth（對…構成嚴重威脅，介詞必須用 to）！
example: Illegally parked vehicles on narrow streets pose a grave safety threat to elderly pedestrians.

def_zh: 使遭受；把（痛苦、傷害或重擔）強加於
def_en: to force someone to experience something very unpleasant
prep_trap: 必考介詞搭配：inflict pain/harm/suffering/damage on sb（把傷害加諸某人身上，介詞必須用 on）！
example: Malicious cyberbullying can inflict lasting psychological trauma on vulnerable teenage victims.

def_zh: 造成（嚴重破壞或混亂）
